public class AmmoStringDisplay : StringDisplay<AmmoStringDisplayInfo>
{
	// Token: 0x06001B7D RID: 7037 RVA: 0x00076304 File Offset: 0x00074504
	protected override string ConvertToString(AmmoStringDisplayInfo newValue)
	{
		if (newValue.isGun)
		{
			return newValue.ammo.ToString() + " / " + newValue.reserve.ToString();
		}

		}
		return "x " + newValue.ammo.ToString();
	}

		if (sync)
		{
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastImpactSFX(pos, (byte)id, -1);
				return;
			}
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
			{
				ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncImpactSFX(pos, (byte)id);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F00 RID: 3840 RVA: 0x000398ED File Offset: 0x00037AED
	public void MyUpdate()

		this.SetFlash();
		this.SetAmbientVolumes();
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F01 RID: 3841 RVA: 0x00039904 File Offset: 0x00037B04
	private void SetAmbientVolumes()
	{
		this.ambientTargetVolume[0] = (ZBMain.instance.mapIsLoaded ? 0f : 1f);
		this.ambientTargetVolume[1] = (ZBMain.instance.mapIsLoaded ? 1f : 0f);
		float num = float.PositiveInfinity;
		Vector2 vector = Camera.main.transform.position.xz();
		Vector2 vector2 = base.transform.position.xz();
		if (ZBMain.instance.mapIsLoaded && MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D != null && MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D.Count > 0)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D.Count; i++)
			{
				int num2 = i + 1;
				if (num2 == MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D.Count)
				{
					num2 = 0;
				}
				Vector2 v = MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D[i].xz();
				Vector2 w = MapGeneration.instance.silhouette3D[num2].xz();
				Vector2 vector3 = GeometryUtils.ClosestPointToLine(v, w, vector);
				float sqrMagnitude = (vector3 - vector).sqrMagnitude;
				if (sqrMagnitude < num)
				{
					num = sqrMagnitude;
					vector2 = vector3;
				}
			}
			vector2 += (vector2 - base.transform.position.xz()).normalized * 150f;
		}
		if (num > this.minDistanceToBeach * this.minDistanceToBeach)
		{
			num = this.minDistanceToBeach * this.minDistanceToBeach;
		}
		this.distanceFromBeachFactor = Mathf.Sqrt(num) / this.minDistanceToBeach;
		this.ambientTargetVolume[1] *= 0.8f + this.distanceFromBeachFactor * 0.2f;
		this.ambientTargetVolume[2] = 1f - this.distanceFromBeachFactor;
		for (int j = 0; j < this.ambientSource.Length; j++)
		{
			this.ambientSource[j].volume = Mathf.Lerp(this.ambientSource[j].volume, this.ambientTargetVolume[j] * this.ambientBaseVolume[j], Time.deltaTime * this.ambientFadeSpeed);
		}
		this.ambientSource[2].transform.position = new Vector3(vector2.x, AuxiliarMapObjects.instance.WaterY, vector2.y);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F02 RID: 3842 RVA: 0x00039B58 File Offset: 0x00037D58
	private void UpdateAudioListenerAndReverb()
	{
		this.targetReverbFactor = 0f;
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain != null && playerMain.gameObject.activeSelf && !BossfightCameraSequence.Active)
		{
			playerMain.playerAudio.listener.enabled = true;
			this.cameraListener.enabled = false;
			if (playerMain.entityLocation.isIndoors)
			{
				this.targetReverbFactor = 1f;
			}
		}
		else
		{
			this.cameraListener.enabled = true;
			if (playerMain != null)
			{
				playerMain.playerAudio.listener.enabled = false;
			}
		}
		this.curReverbFactor = Mathf.MoveTowards(this.curReverbFactor, this.targetReverbFactor, this.reverbFactorLerpSpeed * Time.deltaTime);
		this.masterMixer.SetFloat("IndoorReverb", Mathf.Lerp(-10000f, this.targetReverb, this.curReverbFactor));
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F03 RID: 3843 RVA: 0x00039C44 File Offset: 0x00037E44
	private void SetFlash()
	{
		float b = this.flashControl.isFlashed ? this.flashControl.GetFlashCoef() : 0f;
		this.flashEffectFactor = Mathf.Lerp(this.flashEffectFactor, b, Time.deltaTime * 6f);
		this.deafEffectSource.volume = Mathf.Clamp01((this.flashEffectFactor - 0.5f) * 2f) * 0.5f;
		this.masterMixer.SetFloat("FlashVolume", 0f - this.flashEffectFactor * 5f);
		this.masterMixer.SetFloat("FlashEQGain", Mathf.Lerp(1f, 0.15f, this.flashEffectFactor));
	}

		if (!this.backupFolder.Exists)
		{

			{
				DeveloperConsole.Log("Couldnt create backup folder.", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);

		{

			if (this.backupTriggerTimer <= 0f)
			{
				this.GenerateBackup();
				this.backupTriggerTimer = -1f;
			}
		}
	}

		if ((float)backupsInfo.backupCount >= this.maxBackupCount)
		{
			this.RemoveBackup(backupsInfo.earliestBackupID.Value);
		}
		int id = (backupsInfo.latestBackupID != null) ? (backupsInfo.latestBackupID.Value + 1) : 1;
		DirectoryInfo directoryInfo = this.GetBackupFolder(id);
		if (!PersistenceController.CreateFolder(directoryInfo))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Couldnt create specific backup folder.", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return;
		}
		foreach (FileInfo fileInfo in this.zb2Folder.GetFiles())
		{
			if (this.relevantFileExtensions.Contains(fileInfo.Extension))
			{
				fileInfo.CopyTo(directoryInfo.FullName + "/" + fileInfo.Name);
			}
		}
		DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
		string str = string.Format("{0}y-{1}m-{2}d, {3}h-{4}m-{5}s", new object[]
		{
			now.Year,
			now.Month,
			now.Day,
			now.Hour,
			now.Minute,
			now.Second
		});

	}

		{
			files[i].Delete();
		}
		DirectoryInfo[] directories = directoryInfo.GetDirectories();
		for (int i = 0; i < directories.Length; i++)
		{

	{
		DirectoryInfo[] directories = this.backupFolder.GetDirectories();
		List<int> list = new List<int>();
		int? earliestBackupID = null;
		int? latestBackupID = null;
		for (int i = 0; i < directories.Length; i++)
		{
			int num;
			if (int.TryParse(directories[i].Name, out num))
			{
				list.Add(num);
				if (earliestBackupID == null || num < earliestBackupID.Value)
				{
					earliestBackupID = new int?(num);
				}
				if (latestBackupID == null || num > latestBackupID.Value)
				{
					latestBackupID = new int?(num);
				}
			}
		}
		return new BackupController.BackupsInfo
		{

			latestBackupID = latestBackupID,
			backupCount = list.Count
		};

	public void DirectConnectToSteamServer(SteamId serverId)

		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Cannot join server now!", LogSource.Client, LogMode.Error, false);
			return;
		}
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Skipping lobby connection!", LogSource.Client, LogMode.Warning, false);
		this.spinnerMenu.StartSpinner(null, "<connecting>", 4f);

	private IEnumerator ConnectToSteamServerCoroutine(SteamId serverId)
	{
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Attempting to join Server = {0}", serverId), LogSource.Client, LogMode.Normal, false);
		this.state = ClientController.State.Connecting;
		SteamConnectionsController.instance.StartClientListening();
		SteamConnectionsController.instance.AcceptPacketsFrom(serverId);
		yield return new WaitForSeconds(1f);
		this.state = ClientController.State.HandShaking;
		SteamConnectionsController.instance.AttemptServerConnection(serverId);
		this.speaker.SendHandshake();
		yield return base.StartCoroutine(this.WaitUntilConnected(5f));
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Successfully joined Server!", LogSource.Client, LogMode.Success, false);
		yield break;
	}

	private IEnumerator WaitUntilConnected(float timeOut)

	private string GetDcMessage()
	{
		string result;
		switch (this.DisconnectionReason)
		{
		case DisconnectionReason.NoMsg:
			result = "<DCreasonUnknown>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.UnknownReason:
			result = "<DCreasonUnknown>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.Version:
			result = "<versionMismatch>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.Password:
			result = "<wrongPassword>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.Capacity:
			result = "<serverIsFull>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.Kick:
			result = "<youveBeenKicked>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.Timeout:
			result = "<clientTimeout>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.ServerClosed:
			result = "<serverClosed>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.NotInSteamLobby:
			result = "<notInSteamLobby>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.NotFriends:
			result = "<notFriends>";
			break;
		case DisconnectionReason.AlreadyConnected:
			result = "<alreadyConnectedToMatch>";
			break;
		default:
			result = "<DCreasonUnknown>";
			break;
		}
		return result;
	}

	// Token: 0x060014EE RID: 5358 RVA: 0x0005CB9C File Offset: 0x0005AD9C
	public void OnDisconnected()
	{
		ClientController.State state = this.state;
		if (state == ClientController.State.Connecting || state == ClientController.State.HandShaking)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Failed to enter server", LogSource.Client);
			this.prompt.EnterPrompt("<failedToConnect>", (this.state == ClientController.State.Connecting) ? "<couldntReachServer>" : this.GetDcMessage(), "<ok>", "", new UnityAction(this.ReturnToServerList), null);
		}
		else if (this.state == ClientController.State.Connected)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Disconnected from server!", LogSource.Client);
			this.prompt.EnterPrompt("<lostConnectionWithServer>", this.GetDcMessage(), "<ok>", "", new UnityAction(this.ReturnToServerList), null);
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("Disconnected from server when not suposed to be connected");
			this.ReturnToPlayMenu();
		}
		this.Shutdown();
	}

	private void SteamFriends_OnGameLobbyJoinRequested(Lobby lobby, SteamId steamID)

	private IEnumerator ConnectToLobbyAsync(SteamId lobbyId, Action failureCallback)
	{
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Attempting to join Steam Lobby = {0}", lobbyId.Value), LogSource.Client, LogMode.Normal, false);
		Task<Lobby?> joinLobbyTask = SteamMatchmaking.JoinLobbyAsync(lobbyId);
		while (!joinLobbyTask.IsCompleted)
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		if (joinLobbyTask.Status != TaskStatus.RanToCompletion || joinLobbyTask.Result == null)
		{
			failureCallback();
			yield break;
		}
		if (!joinLobbyTask.Result.Value.Id.IsValid)
		{

			yield break;
		}
		this.ConnectedLobby = joinLobbyTask.Result.Value;
		this.IsConnected = true;
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Successfully joined Steam Lobby !", LogSource.Client, LogMode.Success, false);
		yield break;
	}

	}
}

using System;

// Token: 0x020000B8 RID: 184
public class ColorSetSelector : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x060004B5 RID: 1205 RVA: 0x00010F34 File Offset: 0x0000F134
	public void Show(SkinDescriptor skinDescriptor, Gender selectedGender, Color[] currentColors)
	{
		this.colorIndexing.Clear();
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.HairColor, 1));
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.SkinColor, 0));
		this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(skinDescriptor.EyeColor, 7));
		int num = 2;
		foreach (SkinColorDescriptor colorDescriptor in skinDescriptor.ColorArray)
		{
			this.colorIndexing.Add(new ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing(colorDescriptor, num));
			num++;
		}
		this.colorIndexing.RemoveAll((ColorSetSelector.DisplayedSlotsIndexing indexing) => indexing.colorDescriptor.GetUsability(selectedGender) == ColorUsability.NotUsed);
		for (int j = 0; j < this.colorIndexing.Count; j++)
		{
			SkinColorDescriptor colorDescriptor2 = this.colorIndexing[j].colorDescriptor;
			ColorUsability usability = colorDescriptor2.GetUsability(selectedGender);
			string translatedName = (usability != ColorUsability.NotUsed) ? TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated(colorDescriptor2.colorTag) : "";
			int textureIndex = this.colorIndexing[j].textureIndex;
			this.slots[j].ShowUsed(translatedName, usability, currentColors[textureIndex], colorDescriptor2.palette);
			this.slots[j].SetIndexing(textureIndex);
			this.slots[j].SetClickAction(new Action<ColorSetSlot>(this.SlotClicked));
		}
		for (int k = this.colorIndexing.Count; k < this.slots.Length; k++)
		{
			this.slots[k].ShowAsUnused();
			this.slots[k].SetIndexing(-1);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060004B6 RID: 1206 RVA: 0x000110EB File Offset: 0x0000F2EB
	private void SlotClicked(ColorSetSlot slot)

	{
		ConsumableAnimationDatabase.instance = this;
		foreach (ConsumableAnimation item in base.GetComponentsInChildren<ConsumableAnimation>())
		{
			this.consumableAnim.Add(item);
		}
		this.consumableAnim.Sort(delegate(ConsumableAnimation x, ConsumableAnimation y)
		{
			if (x.id > y.id)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.id != y.id)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		});
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F2E RID: 3886 RVA: 0x0003A798 File Offset: 0x00038998
	public ConsumableAnimation GetAnimation(string animName)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < this.consumableAnim.Count; i++)
		{
			if (this.consumableAnim[i].Name.Equals(animName))

		}

	}

using System;
using UnityEngine;

// Token: 0x0200032B RID: 811
public class CraftingMaterialsListView : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06001AA2 RID: 6818 RVA: 0x000721A0 File Offset: 0x000703A0
	public bool Show(CraftingRecipe.Material[] recipeMaterials, int craftMultiplier = 1)
	{
		if (this.items == null)
		{
			this.items = base.GetComponentsInChildren<CraftingRecipeViewItem>();
		}
		CraftingRecipeViewItem[] array = this.items;
		for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
		{
			array[i].Hide();
		}
		PlayerInventory inventory = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer().inventory;
		bool flag = true;
		for (int j = 0; j < recipeMaterials.Length; j++)
		{
			InventoryItem.ID id = recipeMaterials[j].id;
			int num = inventory.TotalItemCount(id);
			int num2 = recipeMaterials[j].stack * craftMultiplier;
			this.items[j].Show(id, num, num2);
			flag = (flag && num >= num2);
		}
		return flag;
	}

	// Token: 0x040012DC RID: 4828
	private CraftingRecipeViewItem[] items;
}

	// Token: 0x06001A92 RID: 6802 RVA: 0x00071F28 File Offset: 0x00070128
	private void TryCraft(InventoryItem.ID currentRecipe, int craftMultiplier)
	{

		if (recipeFor.CanCraft(findPlayerInventory, craftMultiplier))
		{
			recipeFor.CraftInto(findPlayerInventory, craftMultiplier);
			AudioController.instance.PlayUIPack(AudioController.UIFXPack.Craft);
			InventoryDisplay.instance.Show(findPlayerInventory);
			this.RefreshRecipeUI();

	}

	public void UpdateDisplay()
	{
		DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion daytimeRegion = this.FindRegion();
		bool isBloodMoon = DaytimeController.instance.IsBloodMoon;
		DaytimeBarDisplay.Preset preset = this.presets[(int)daytimeRegion];
		this.celestialBodyTransform.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(this.barRect.rect.width * (DaytimeController.instance.curTime / 24f), preset.height);
		this.celestialBodyTransform.sizeDelta = new Vector2(preset.size, preset.size);
		this.celestialBodyImage.sprite = preset.sprite;
		if (isBloodMoon)
		{
			this.timer += Time.deltaTime * 4f;
			if (this.timer > 6.2831855f)
			{
				this.timer = 0f;
			}
			this.celestialBodyImage.color = Color.Lerp(preset.color, Colors.red, this.NormalizedSin(this.timer));
			return;
		}
		this.celestialBodyImage.color = preset.color;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C88 RID: 3208 RVA: 0x00030DD5 File Offset: 0x0002EFD5
	private float NormalizedSin(float t)
	{
		return (Mathf.Sin(t) + 1f) * 0.5f;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C89 RID: 3209 RVA: 0x00030DEC File Offset: 0x0002EFEC
	private DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion FindRegion()
	{
		float curTime = DaytimeController.instance.curTime;
		if (curTime < 18f)
		{
			if (curTime < 5.5f)
			{
				if (curTime >= 0f)
				{
					return DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion.LateNightTime;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (curTime >= 7f)
				{
					return DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion.DayTime;
				}
				return DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion.Sunrise;
			}
		}
		else if (curTime < 19.5f)
		{
			return DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion.Sunset;
		}
		return DaytimeBarDisplay.DaytimeRegion.EarlyNightTime;
	}

	public void RandomizeRegionPositions(float width)
	{
		float num = width / 2f;
		System.Random random = new System.Random();
		float num2 = (float)(random.NextDouble() * 360.0);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.locations.Length; i++)
		{
			float num3 = num2 + (float)(360 / this.locations.Length * i);
			num3 += (float)random.Next(-30, 30);
			float radius = num * Mathf.Lerp(0.2f, 0.6f, (float)random.NextDouble());
			Vector3 vector = MapGeneration.instance.silhouetteAveragePoint;
			Vector3 b = PolarCoord.GetPoint(radius, num3).x0y(0f);
			vector += b;
			vector.y = 0f;
			this.locations[i].position = vector;
		}
	}

			{
				this.Clear();
			}
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < this.indicators.Count; i++)
		{

			{
				color.a = 0f;
			}
			this.indicators[i].img.color = color;
			this.indicators[i].transform.localScale = new Vector3(1f, this.scaleCurve.Evaluate(this.indicators[i].timer), 1f);
			this.indicators[i].transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(new Vector3(0f, 0f, this.indicators[i].angle + playerMain.transform.eulerAngles.y));
			this.indicators[i].timer += Time.deltaTime * this.fadeSpeed;
			if (this.indicators[i].timer > 1f)
			{
				UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.indicators[i].gameObject);
				this.indicators.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
		}
	}

		location.indoorFloor = Mathf.Clamp(location.indoorFloor, 0, getPolygon.building.MultiFloor ? (getPolygon.building.FloorCount - 1) : getPolygon.building.FloorCount);
		Vector3 vector = location.pos3d;
		if (location.tryShiftingTowardsIndoorsOnHigherFloors && location.indoorFloor > 0)
		{
			vector = this.ShiftTowardsIndoors(vector, getPolygon);
		}
		location.indoorCell = getPolygon.building.GetCellCoord(vector);
		if (!getPolygon.building.IsInBuildingGrid(location.indoorCell))
		{

			return;

	private Vector3 ShiftTowardsIndoors(Vector3 position3D, Polygon poly)
	{

		{

			box2DFromFoundation.AddPadding(-num2);
			PointIntersection pointIntersection = PointIntersection.Between(box2DFromFoundation, point);
			float magnitude = pointIntersection.edgeFacingVector.magnitude;
			if (!pointIntersection.Exists && magnitude < num + num2)
			{
				return pointIntersection.ShiftToEdge(point).x0y(position3D.y);
			}
		}
		return position3D;
	}

	private void RecalculateLocation(EntityLocation location)

		if (terrainFeature != null)

		}
		if (!this.scanNeighbourCells)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < GeometryUtils.directions.Length; i++)

	// Token: 0x0600101E RID: 4126 RVA: 0x0003DFE4 File Offset: 0x0003C1E4
	private TerrainFeature FindCellFeature(EntityLocation location, HashCell cell)
	{
		Vector3 pos3d = location.pos3d;
		Vector2 point = pos3d.xz();
		for (int i = 0; i < cell.polygons.Count; i++)
		{
			if (GeometryUtils.PointInPolygon(cell.polygons[i], point))
			{
				return cell.polygons[i];
			}
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < cell.edges.Count; j++)
		{
			GridEdge gridEdge = cell.edges[j];
			if (GeometryUtils.PointInTriangle(gridEdge.node3d[0].xz(), gridEdge.node3d[1].xz(), gridEdge.node3d[2].xz(), pos3d.xz()))
			{
				return gridEdge;
			}
			if (GeometryUtils.PointInTriangle(gridEdge.node3d[2].xz(), gridEdge.node3d[3].xz(), gridEdge.node3d[0].xz(), pos3d.xz()))
			{
				return gridEdge;
			}
			if (gridEdge.IntersectBeach(pos3d))
			{
				location.isOnBeach = true;
				return gridEdge;
			}
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < cell.nodesWithSize.Count; k++)
		{
			GridNode gridNode = cell.nodesWithSize[k];
			for (int l = 1; l < gridNode.roadPoints.Count - 1; l++)
			{
				if (GeometryUtils.PointInTriangle(gridNode.roadPoints[0].point.xz(), gridNode.roadPoints[l].point.xz(), gridNode.roadPoints[l + 1].point.xz(), pos3d.xz()))
				{
					return gridNode;
				}
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

public class EquipmentHUD : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x060019ED RID: 6637 RVA: 0x0006F5A4 File Offset: 0x0006D7A4
	public void UpdateDisplay(PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		foreach (EquipmentHUDSlot equipmentHUDSlot in this.slots)
		{
			InventoryItem equippedItem = EquipmentHUD.GetEquippedItem(equipmentHUDSlot, targetPlayer);
			EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode displayMode = EquipmentHUD.GetDisplayMode(equipmentHUDSlot, equippedItem, targetPlayer);
			if (equipmentHUDSlot.IsFreeHands)
			{
				equipmentHUDSlot.ShowFreehands(this.freehandsSprite, displayMode);
			}
			else
			{
				equipmentHUDSlot.Show(equippedItem, targetPlayer.inventory, displayMode);
			}
		}
		this.miscItems.Show(targetPlayer.inventory);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019EE RID: 6638 RVA: 0x0006F638 File Offset: 0x0006D838
	private static InventoryItem GetEquippedItem(EquipmentHUDSlot slot, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		if (slot.IsFreeHands)
		{
			return null;
		}
		return targetPlayer.inventory.GetEquipment(slot.Index);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019EF RID: 6639 RVA: 0x0006F655 File Offset: 0x0006D855
	private static EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode GetDisplayMode(EquipmentHUDSlot slot, InventoryItem equippedItem, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		return EquipmentHUD.GetDisplayMode(slot.IsFreeHands, slot.Index, equippedItem, targetPlayer);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019F0 RID: 6640 RVA: 0x0006F66C File Offset: 0x0006D86C
	public static EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode GetDisplayMode(bool isFreeHands, EquipmentIndex index, InventoryItem equippedItem, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		if (equippedItem == null && !isFreeHands)
		{
			return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Hide;
		}
		if (index.Equals(targetPlayer.arms.selectedItem))
		{
			return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Highlight;
		}
		if (index.Equals(targetPlayer.arms.targetEquipment))
		{
			return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Select;
		}
		return EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode.Fade;
	}

	public void Show(PlayerInventory inventory)
	{
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < this.slots.Length; i++)
		{
			EquipmentIndex equipmentIndex = EquipmentIndex.Misc(i);
			InventoryItem inventoryItem = inventory.equippedItems.Get(equipmentIndex);
			if (inventoryItem.IsEmpty())
			{
				this.slots[i].gameObject.SetActive(false);
			}
			else
			{
				num++;
				this.slots[i].gameObject.SetActive(true);
				EquipmentHUDSlot.Mode displayMode = EquipmentHUD.GetDisplayMode(false, equipmentIndex, inventoryItem, inventory.playerMain);
				this.slots[i].Show(inventory, inventoryItem, displayMode);
			}
		}
		base.gameObject.SetActive(num > 0);
		float y = (num > 5) ? 100f : 60f;
		RectTransform rectTransform = base.transform as RectTransform;
		rectTransform.sizeDelta = rectTransform.sizeDelta.ReplaceY(y);
	}

	{
		yield return DebugOverlayMenus.instance;
		yield return DonationMenu.Find;
		yield return ChangeLogWindow.Find;
		yield return BossfightCameraSequence.instance;
		yield return PhotoMode.Instance;

		yield return MenuController.instance;

	// Token: 0x060009FB RID: 2555 RVA: 0x00026D18 File Offset: 0x00024F18
	public void MyUpdate()
	{
		if (!Input.GetKeyDown(KeyCode.Escape))
		{
			return;
		}
		using (IEnumerator<IEscKeyConsumerMenu> enumerator = EscKeyManager.Consumers().GetEnumerator())
		{

					break;

			}
		}
	}

	public void ProcessLocalExplosion(Vector3 origin, Explosion.ID explosionID, bool isZombieExplosion)
	{

		{

	// Token: 0x06000FF8 RID: 4088 RVA: 0x0003D240 File Offset: 0x0003B440
	public void ProcessExplosion(Vector3 origin, Explosion.ID explosionID, int sourceLobbyID, bool isZombieExplosion)
	{
		Explosion explosion = this.predefExplosion[explosionID - Explosion.ID.BossFlash];
		int playerID = isZombieExplosion ? -1 : sourceLobbyID;
		DebugUtils.DrawCircle(origin + Vector3.up * 0.1f, Vector3.up, explosion.rangeMeters, Colors.red, 5f, 20);
		this.ProcessExplosionAgainstMyPlayer(origin, explosion, playerID);
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsServer())
		{
			this.ProcessExplosionAgainstZombies(origin, explosion, playerID);
			this.ProcessExplosionAgainstFurniture(origin, explosion);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000FF9 RID: 4089 RVA: 0x0003D2B8 File Offset: 0x0003B4B8
	private void ProcessExplosionAgainstFurniture(Vector3 origin, Explosion explosionSettings)
	{
		List<InteractableFurniture> furniture = OptimizedFurnitureHash.instance.GetFurniture(origin);
		for (int i = 0; i < furniture.Count; i++)
		{
			if (furniture[i].IsDestroyable)
			{
				Vector3 position = furniture[i].refFXTransform.position;
				ExplosionResult explosionResult = this.ExplosionResultFor(origin, position, null, explosionSettings, true);
				if (explosionResult.damage > 1f)
				{
					Damage damage = new Damage(explosionResult.damage, position, DamageType.Unknown);
					Damage.ProcessDamage(furniture[i], damage, true);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000FFA RID: 4090 RVA: 0x0003D33C File Offset: 0x0003B53C
	private void ProcessExplosionAgainstZombies(Vector3 origin, Explosion explosionSettings, int playerID)
	{
		PlayerMain player = PlayersController.instance.GetPlayer(playerID);
		this.GenerateZombieExplosionResults(origin, explosionSettings);
		this.zombieExplosionResults.Sort((ValueTuple<Zombie, ExplosionResult> x, ValueTuple<Zombie, ExplosionResult> y) => y.Item2.hitDistanceFactor.CompareTo(x.Item2.hitDistanceFactor));
		float num = explosionSettings.maxTotalDamage;
		foreach (ValueTuple<Zombie, ExplosionResult> valueTuple in this.zombieExplosionResults)
		{
			Zombie item = valueTuple.Item1;
			ExplosionResult item2 = valueTuple.Item2;
			float num2 = item2.damage;
			if (num2 > 1f && num > 0f)
			{
				num2 = Mathf.Min(num, num2);
				num2 = Mathf.Min(item.health.amount, num2);
				Damage damage = new Damage(num2, item2.targetPosition, DamageType.Explosion, new ZombieDamage(player, new Stagger(explosionSettings.dmgStagger, 1f), LimbID.Unknown));
				Damage.ProcessDamage(item, damage, true);
				num -= num2;
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000FFB RID: 4091 RVA: 0x0003D450 File Offset: 0x0003B650
	private void GenerateZombieExplosionResults(Vector3 origin, Explosion explosionSettings)
	{
		this.zombieExplosionResults.Clear();
		List<Zombie> zombies = ZombieLoader.Instance.zombies;
		for (int i = 0; i < zombies.Count; i++)
		{
			Zombie zombie = zombies[i];
			Vector3 position = zombie.obj.transform.position;
			ExplosionResult item = this.ExplosionResultFor(origin, position, null, explosionSettings, true);
			if (item.HasAnyEffect)
			{
				this.zombieExplosionResults.Add(new ValueTuple<Zombie, ExplosionResult>(zombie, item));
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000FFC RID: 4092 RVA: 0x0003D4C8 File Offset: 0x0003B6C8
	private void ProcessExplosionAgainstMyPlayer(Vector3 origin, Explosion explosionSettings, int playerID)
	{
		PlayerMain player = PlayersController.instance.GetPlayer(playerID);
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		ExplosionResult explosionResult = this.ExplosionResultFor(origin, playerMain.transform.position, playerMain.transform, explosionSettings, false);
		if (explosionResult.flash > 0f)
		{
			this.flashControl.SetFlashed(explosionResult.flash, explosionResult.flashTurned);
		}
		if (explosionResult.damage > 1f)
		{
			if (player != null)
			{
				explosionResult.damage *= ((player != playerMain) ? 0.1f : 0.5f);
			}
			Damage damage = new Damage(explosionResult.damage, playerMain.transform.position, DamageType.Explosion, new PlayerDamage(explosionResult.direction, 0.5f, true, 1f));
			Damage.ProcessDamage(playerMain, damage, true);
		}
		if (explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor > 0f && explosionSettings.seAmount > 0f)
		{
			playerMain.statusEffects.AddEffect(explosionSettings.seID, explosionSettings.seAmount, 0f);
		}
		if (explosionSettings.rangeMeters > 0f && explosionResult.shakeFactor > 0f)
		{
			playerMain.cam.Shake(2.5f * explosionResult.shakeFactor, 0.75f * explosionResult.shakeFactor, 1.5f);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000FFD RID: 4093 RVA: 0x0003D61C File Offset: 0x0003B81C
	public ExplosionResult ExplosionResultFor(Vector3 origin, Vector3 targetPosition, Transform cameraTransform, Explosion explosionSettings, bool saturateDamage)
	{
		ExplosionResult explosionResult;
		explosionResult.targetPosition = targetPosition;
		explosionResult.direction = (origin - targetPosition).normalized;
		float num = Vector3.Distance(origin, targetPosition);
		explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor = 1f - Mathf.Clamp01(num / explosionSettings.rangeMeters);
		if (saturateDamage && explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor > 0f)
		{
			explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor = Mathf.Clamp01(explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor / 0.5f);
		}
		if (Mathf.Approximately(explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor, 0f))
		{
			explosionResult.flash = 0f;
			explosionResult.flashTurned = false;
			explosionResult.damage = 0f;
		}
		else
		{
			bool flag = Physics.Raycast(targetPosition, explosionResult.direction, num, this.expMask);
			explosionResult.flashTurned = false;
			if (flag)
			{
				explosionResult.flash = 0f;
				explosionResult.damage = 0f;
			}
			else
			{
				explosionResult.flash = (1f - Mathf.Clamp01(num / explosionSettings.rangeMeters)) * explosionSettings.flashDuration;
				if (cameraTransform)
				{
					explosionResult.flashTurned = (Vector3.Dot(explosionResult.direction, cameraTransform.forward) < 0f || flag);
				}
				explosionResult.damage = 0f;
				if (num < explosionSettings.rangeMeters)
				{
					explosionResult.damage = Mathf.Lerp(explosionSettings.dmgMin, explosionSettings.dmgMax, explosionResult.hitDistanceFactor);
				}
			}
		}
		explosionResult.shakeFactor = 1f - Mathf.Clamp01(num / (explosionSettings.rangeMeters * 10f));
		return explosionResult;
	}

public class FOVController : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x1700018C RID: 396
	// (get) Token: 0x060007B0 RID: 1968 RVA: 0x0001CA27 File Offset: 0x0001AC27
	// (set) Token: 0x060007B1 RID: 1969 RVA: 0x0001CA2F File Offset: 0x0001AC2F

	// Token: 0x060007B2 RID: 1970 RVA: 0x0001CA38 File Offset: 0x0001AC38
	private void Update()
	{
		float b = FOVController.BaseFOV;
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		if (playerMain != null)
		{
			this.curZoom = this.GetCurrentZoom(playerMain);
			b = FOVController.UserDefinedFOV / this.curZoom;
		}
		this.CurrentFOV = Mathf.Lerp(this.cam.fieldOfView, b, Time.deltaTime * this.lerpSpeed);
		this.cam.fieldOfView = this.CurrentFOV;
	}

	// Token: 0x060007B3 RID: 1971 RVA: 0x0001CAAD File Offset: 0x0001ACAD

	}

	// Token: 0x060007B4 RID: 1972 RVA: 0x0001CACC File Offset: 0x0001ACCC
	private float GetCurrentZoom(PlayerMain player)
	{
		if (player.SpawnedSkin != null && player.arms.EquippedGun != null && player.arms.fightModeCoef > 1f)
		{
			if (player.arms.EquippedGun.DbReference.adsZoomLevel > this.maxZoom)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Zoom level above maximum");
			}
			return Mathf.Lerp(1f, player.arms.EquippedGun.DbReference.adsZoomLevel, player.arms.fightModeCoef - 1f);
		}
		return Mathf.Lerp(1f, 1.1f, player.arms.fightModeCoef - 1f);
	}

	// Token: 0x060019D2 RID: 6610 RVA: 0x0006E8BC File Offset: 0x0006CABC
	private void UpdatePing()
	{
		this.pingUpdateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.pingUpdateFreq;
		if (this.pingUpdateTimer > 1f)
		{
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
			{
				this.ping = ClientController.instance.myPingInMS;
				this.pingText.text = "Ping: " + this.ping.ToString() + "ms";
			}
			else
			{
				this.ping = 0;
				this.pingText.text = "Server";
			}
			float num = SteamConnectionsController.instance.TotalDownloadRate / 1000f;
			float num2 = SteamConnectionsController.instance.TotalUploadRate / 1000f;
			this.downText.text = "Down: " + num.ToString("0.00") + "kb/s";
			this.upText.text = "Up: " + num2.ToString("0.00") + "kb/s";
			this.pingUpdateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060019D3 RID: 6611 RVA: 0x0006E9C8 File Offset: 0x0006CBC8
	private void UpdateFPS()
	{
		this.fpsPoolTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.fpsPoolingFreq;
		if (this.fpsPoolTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.accFPS += 1f / Time.unscaledDeltaTime;
			this.FPSPoolCount += 1f;
			this.fpsPoolTimer = 0f;
		}
		this.fpsUpdateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.fpsUpdateFreq;
		if (this.fpsUpdateTimer > 1f)
		{
			if (this.FPSPoolCount >= 1f)
			{
				this.fps = this.accFPS / this.FPSPoolCount;
				this.accFPS = 0f;
				this.FPSPoolCount = 0f;
				this.fpsText.text = "FPS: " + ((int)this.fps).ToString();
				if (Application.targetFrameRate > 0)
				{
					TMP_Text tmp_Text = this.fpsText;
					tmp_Text.text = tmp_Text.text + "/" + Application.targetFrameRate.ToString();
				}
			}
			this.fpsUpdateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

// Token: 0x02000218 RID: 536
public class FXPropsController : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000F64 RID: 3940 RVA: 0x0003B180 File Offset: 0x00039380
	public void Init()
	{
		FXPropsController.instance = this;
		this.limitedProps = new List<FXProp>();
		this.unlimitedProps = new List<FXProp>();
		if (this.holder == null)
		{
			GameObject gameObject = new GameObject("FX Prop Holder");
			this.holder = gameObject.transform;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F65 RID: 3941 RVA: 0x0003B1D0 File Offset: 0x000393D0
	public void RegisterProp(FXProp fxProp)
	{
		fxProp.PoolID = -1;
		fxProp.transform.parent = this.holder;
		if (fxProp.body != null)
		{
			fxProp.body.isKinematic = false;
		}
		(fxProp.ignoreLimit ? this.unlimitedProps : this.limitedProps).Add(fxProp);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F66 RID: 3942 RVA: 0x0003B22B File Offset: 0x0003942B
	public FXProp SpawnProp(FXProp.ID id, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Transform attachransform = null, bool syncOnline = false)
	{
		return this.SpawnProp(id, position, rotation, Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero, attachransform, syncOnline);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F67 RID: 3943 RVA: 0x0003B244 File Offset: 0x00039444
	public FXProp SpawnProp(FXProp.ID id, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation, Vector3 startVelocity, Vector3 startAngularVelocity, Transform attachTransform = null, bool syncOnline = false)
	{
		FXProp fxprop = this.propPrefab[(int)id];
		if (fxprop == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError(string.Format("Trying to spawn non existing Prop '{0}'", id));
			return null;
		}
		FXProp fxprop2 = this.PropsPool.Instantiate(fxprop, position, rotation, this.holder);
		GameObject gameObject = fxprop2.gameObject;
		if (attachTransform != null)
		{
			gameObject.transform.parent = attachTransform;
		}
		fxprop2.Setup(startVelocity, startAngularVelocity);
		(fxprop2.ignoreLimit ? this.unlimitedProps : this.limitedProps).Add(fxprop2);
		if (syncOnline)
		{
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastFXPropPos(id, position, -1);
			}
			else if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
			{
				ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncFXPropPos(id, position);
			}
		}
		return fxprop2;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F68 RID: 3944 RVA: 0x0003B318 File Offset: 0x00039518
	public void Update()
	{
		if (Pause.IsPaused)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.ProcessProps(this.limitedProps);
		this.ProcessProps(this.unlimitedProps);
		while (this.limitedProps.Count > this.maxProps)
		{
			this.ReturnToPool(this.limitedProps[0]);
			this.limitedProps.RemoveAt(0);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F69 RID: 3945 RVA: 0x0003B378 File Offset: 0x00039578
	private void ReturnToPool(FXProp prop)
	{
		if (prop.PoolID < 0)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(prop.gameObject);
			return;
		}
		prop.transform.SetParent(this.holder, true);
		this.PropsPool.Release(prop);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F6A RID: 3946 RVA: 0x0003B3B0 File Offset: 0x000395B0
	private void ProcessProps(List<FXProp> props)
	{
		if (props == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < props.Count; i++)
		{
			FXProp fxprop = props[i];
			if (fxprop == null)
			{
				props.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
			else
			{
				fxprop.timer += Time.deltaTime;
				if (fxprop.timer > fxprop.defaultTimeout)
				{
					this.ReturnToPool(fxprop);
					props.RemoveAtWithoutShifting(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	private readonly PrefabPool<FXProp> PropsPool = new PrefabPool<FXProp>();
}

	private void UpdateButtons()

		foreach (GameModeButton gameModeButton in this.buttons)
		{
			bool unlocked = GameModeSelector.IsUnlocked(gameModeButton.GameModeOption);
			bool selected = gameModeButton.GameModeOption == this.SelectedGameModeOption;
			gameModeButton.UpdateDisplay(unlocked, selected, isClient);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000842 RID: 2114 RVA: 0x0001E80D File Offset: 0x0001CA0D
	public static bool IsUnlocked(GameModeOption modeOption)

	}

	// Token: 0x06000843 RID: 2115 RVA: 0x0001E824 File Offset: 0x0001CA24
	private void UpdateButtonsEvents()
	{
		GameModeButton[] array = this.buttons;

		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000844 RID: 2116 RVA: 0x0001E84F File Offset: 0x0001CA4F
	public void SelectMode(GameModeOption option)
	{

			this.SelectMode(GameModeOption.BreakoutEasy);
			return;
		}
		this.SelectedGameModeOption = option;
		this.UpdateButtons();
		LobbyMenu.instance.OnGameModeChanged();
	}

	{

		this.text.color = (success ? this.textGreen : this.textRed);

	// Token: 0x06000D86 RID: 3462 RVA: 0x00034EA8 File Offset: 0x000330A8
	private void UpdateAnimation(float normalizedTime)
	{
		this.canvasGroup.alpha = Mathf.Clamp01(normalizedTime * 3f);
		float y = Mathf.Lerp(0f, 200f, normalizedTime * 5f);
		this.horizontalStripe.sizeDelta = new Vector2(this.horizontalStripe.sizeDelta.x, y);
		float num = Mathf.Lerp(0.75f, 1.25f, normalizedTime);
		this.textTranform.localScale = new Vector3(num, num, 1f);
	}

public class GeneralTierProgressPanel : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000D17 RID: 3351 RVA: 0x00032E36 File Offset: 0x00031036
	private void OnEnable()
	{
		this.UpdateDisplay();
	}

	// Token: 0x06000D18 RID: 3352 RVA: 0x00032E40 File Offset: 0x00031040
	private void UpdateDisplay()
	{
		this.unavailableInDemoPanel.SetActive(!ZBVersion.Instance.IsPaid);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.tierDisplay.Length; i++)
		{
			float percetange = this.FindPercentage(i + 1);
			this.tierDisplay[i].Show(percetange);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000D19 RID: 3353 RVA: 0x00032E90 File Offset: 0x00031090
	private float FindPercentage(int tier)
	{
		float num = (float)this.loadoutUnlocker.AllLoadoutsOfTier(tier, true).Length;
		if (Mathf.Approximately(num, 0f))
		{
			return 0f;
		}
		float num2 = (float)this.loadoutUnlocker.AllAvailableLoadouts(tier, false).Count;
		return 1f - num2 / num;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F90 RID: 3984 RVA: 0x0003B864 File Offset: 0x00039A64
	public void OnCellGenerated(HashCell hashcell)
	{
		int num = 0;
		GlobalInteractionController.GICCell giccell = new GlobalInteractionController.GICCell(hashcell);
		this.cell[hashcell.coordinate.x, hashcell.coordinate.y] = giccell;
		for (int i = 0; i < hashcell.polygons.Count; i++)
		{
			List<InteractableFurniture> list = new List<InteractableFurniture>();
			for (int j = 0; j < hashcell.polygons[i].allInteractableFurniture.Count; j++)
			{
				Furniture furniture = hashcell.polygons[i].allInteractableFurniture[j];
				if (furniture.hasInteraction || furniture.destroyable)
				{
					InteractableFurniture component = furniture.GetComponent<InteractableFurniture>();
					component.sortID = furniture.interactionID;
					component.sortSubID = this.PullID();
					component.cellCoordinate = hashcell.coordinate;
					component.cellID = num;
					list.Add(component);
					num++;
					this.optFurnitureHash.AddFurniture(component);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				GlobalInteractionController.GICPolygon item = new GlobalInteractionController.GICPolygon(hashcell.polygons[i])
				{
					interFurni = list
				};
				giccell.polys.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F91 RID: 3985 RVA: 0x0003B998 File Offset: 0x00039B98
	public void UpdateDynamicFurniture()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < this.dynamicFurniture.Count; i++)
		{
			InteractableFurniture interactableFurniture = this.dynamicFurniture[i];
			if (interactableFurniture.sortID == InteractableObject.ID.Door)
			{
				Quaternion to = Quaternion.Euler(-90f, 0f, 0f);
				if (interactableFurniture.state == 0)
				{
					to = Quaternion.Euler(-90f, 80f, 0f);
				}
				else if (interactableFurniture.state == 2)
				{
					to = Quaternion.Euler(-90f, -80f, 0f);
				}
				interactableFurniture.doorPanelBody.transform.localRotation = Quaternion.RotateTowards(interactableFurniture.doorPanelBody.transform.localRotation, to, Time.deltaTime * 180f);
			}
			interactableFurniture.dynamicTimer += Time.deltaTime;
			if (interactableFurniture.dynamicTimer > interactableFurniture.dynamicTimeout)
			{
				this.dynamicFurniture.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F92 RID: 3986 RVA: 0x0003BA8D File Offset: 0x00039C8D

		{
			this.dynamicFurniture.Add(interactableFurniture);
		}
		interactableFurniture.dynamicTimer = 0f;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F93 RID: 3987 RVA: 0x0003BAB4 File Offset: 0x00039CB4

	// Token: 0x06000F94 RID: 3988 RVA: 0x0003BAC3 File Offset: 0x00039CC3

	}

	// Token: 0x06000F95 RID: 3989 RVA: 0x0003BAD8 File Offset: 0x00039CD8
	public void InteractedWith(InteractableFurniture interactableFurniture, PlayerMain player, Vector3 pos, Vector3 moveDirection)
	{
		this.InteractedWith(interactableFurniture, player, pos, moveDirection, byte.MaxValue);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F96 RID: 3990 RVA: 0x0003BAEC File Offset: 0x00039CEC
	private void InteractedWith(InteractableFurniture interactableFurniture, PlayerMain player, Vector3 pos, Vector3 moveDirection, byte targetState)
	{
		if (interactableFurniture == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (targetState == 255 && interactableFurniture.targetFurniture.interactionID == InteractableObject.ID.Door)
		{
			targetState = (byte)GlobalInteractionController.HandleDoorInteraction(interactableFurniture, player, pos, moveDirection);
		}
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
		{
			ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncFurnitureInteraction(interactableFurniture.cellCoordinate, interactableFurniture.cellID, targetState);
			return;
		}
		interactableFurniture.ApplyInteraction(targetState);
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
		{
			interactableFurniture.ServerSideStateBroadcast();
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F97 RID: 3991 RVA: 0x0003BB6C File Offset: 0x00039D6C
	private static DoorState HandleDoorInteraction(InteractableFurniture interactableFurniture, PlayerMain player, Vector3 pos, Vector3 moveDirection)
	{
		DoorState doorState = interactableFurniture.DoorState;
		if (doorState == DoorState.Locked)
		{
			if (!interactableFurniture.CanUnlockDoor(player))
			{
				return DoorState.Locked;
			}
			interactableFurniture.RemoveKeyForThisDoor(player);
		}
		if (doorState != DoorState.Closed && doorState != DoorState.Locked)
		{
			return DoorState.Closed;
		}
		float num = Vector3.Dot(interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.right, moveDirection.normalized);
		if (Vector3.Dot(interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.right, (pos - interactableFurniture.refFXTransform.position).normalized) < 0f)
		{
			if (num < 0f && moveDirection.magnitude > 0.5f)
			{
				return DoorState.OpenedForward;
			}
			return DoorState.OpenedBackward;
		}
		else
		{
			if (num > 0f && moveDirection.magnitude > 0.5f)
			{
				return DoorState.OpenedBackward;
			}
			return DoorState.OpenedForward;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F98 RID: 3992 RVA: 0x0003BC1C File Offset: 0x00039E1C
	internal void OnSyncWorkbenchDiscovery(int cellX, int cellY, int furniID)
	{
		if (!this.Initialized)
		{
			return;
		}
		InteractableFurniture furniture = this.GetFurniture(cellX, cellY, furniID);
		if (!furniture)
		{
			Debug.Log("Didnt find furniture" + furniID.ToString());
			return;
		}
		WorkbenchInteractable workbenchInteractable = furniture as WorkbenchInteractable;
		if (workbenchInteractable == null)
		{
			Debug.Log("Furniture is not a workbench. Cant be discovered.");
			return;
		}
		InteractableFurniture.OnDiscoveredWorkbench(workbenchInteractable);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000F99 RID: 3993 RVA: 0x0003BC78 File Offset: 0x00039E78
	internal void OnSyncPyreLightup(int cellX, int cellY, int furniID)
	{
		if (!this.Initialized)
		{
			return;
		}
		InteractableFurniture furniture = this.GetFurniture(cellX, cellY, furniID);
		if (!furniture)
		{
			Debug.Log("Didnt find furniture" + furniID.ToString());
			return;
		}
		PyreInteractable pyreInteractable = furniture as PyreInteractable;
		if (pyreInteractable == null)
		{
			Debug.Log("Furniture is not a Pyre. Cant be lit up.");
			return;
		}
		if (pyreInteractable.IsLit)
		{
			Debug.Log("Pyre already lit. Wont light up again. Client will lose resources.");
			return;
		}
		pyreInteractable.LightUp();
		pyreInteractable.ServerSideStateBroadcast();
	}

	public InteractableFurniture GetFurnitureFromCell(GlobalInteractionController.GICCell c, int id)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < c.polys.Count; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < c.polys[i].interFurni.Count; j++)
			{

	public InteractableFurniture GetFurniture(int cellX, int cellY, int id)
	{
		if (this.cell == null)
		{
			Debug.LogException(new Exception("Global Interaction hash cells not Initialized"));
			return null;
		}
		GlobalInteractionController.GICCell giccell = this.cell[cellX, cellY];
		if (giccell == null)
		{
			return null;
		}
		InteractableFurniture furnitureFromCell = this.GetFurnitureFromCell(giccell, id);
		if (furnitureFromCell == null)
		{
			Debug.LogException(new Exception(string.Format("ID {0} non existing for Ifurniture inside cell. Client Side [OnFurnitureData]", id)));
			return null;

{
	// Token: 0x0600025C RID: 604 RVA: 0x00009B88 File Offset: 0x00007D88
	public void BakeData(Vector3 landingPoint, Vector3 landingForward)
	{
		this.landingForward = landingForward.xz().normalized;
		Vector2 p1_ = landingPoint.xz() - landingForward.xz() * this.backPointDistance;
		Vector2 vector = landingPoint.xz() + landingForward.xz() * this.forwardPointDistance;
		Vector2 p2_ = landingPoint.xz() + landingForward.xz() * (this.forwardPointDistance + 2f);
		this.interiorLine = new Line2D(p1_, vector);
		this.extendedInteriorLine = new Line2D(p1_, p2_);
		this.midPoint = this.interiorLine.MidPoint();
		this.rampPoint = vector + landingForward.xz();
	}

	// Token: 0x0600025D RID: 605 RVA: 0x00009C44 File Offset: 0x00007E44
	public PathingOrder AvoidHelicopter(Vector2 fromPoint, Vector2 toPoint, PathingOrder order)
	{
		if (!HelicopterLanding.Instance.HelicopterIsLanded)
		{
			return order;
		}
		if (GeometryUtils.ManhatanDistance(fromPoint, this.midPoint) > this.baseManhatanDistance)
		{
			return order;
		}
		if (this.IsInside(toPoint, this.interiorLine))
		{
			return this.AvoidHelicopterWithTargetInside(fromPoint, order);
		}
		return this.AvoidHelicopterWithTargetOutside(fromPoint, toPoint, order);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600025E RID: 606 RVA: 0x00009C98 File Offset: 0x00007E98

	{

	private void StartEndingCutsceneServerSide()

			{
				this.CameraSequence.Begin();
			}
		}
		ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SendRescuedPlayerList(list);
		foreach (Zombie zombie in this.AllZombiesInsideHeli())
		{
			zombie.TakeDamage(new Damage(10000f, zombie.obj.transform.position, DamageType.Unknown));
		}
		this.RescuedPlayersCount = list.Count;
		this.BroadcastState();
	}

	// Token: 0x060002A3 RID: 675 RVA: 0x0000B0C0 File Offset: 0x000092C0

		{

		}
		if (this.EndingState == HelicopterTakeoffState.Cutscene && this.CameraSequence.ReachedEnd(this.flightDistance) && this.IsServer)
		{

	// Token: 0x060002A7 RID: 679 RVA: 0x0000B1C8 File Offset: 0x000093C8
	private void SnapToLandingRotation(bool instant)

	// Token: 0x060002A9 RID: 681 RVA: 0x0000B248 File Offset: 0x00009448
	private void SetHelicopterFlightPositionAndRotation(HeliPathBezier bezier, float distance, bool isLanding)
	{

		Vector3 item = valueTuple.Item1;
		float item2 = valueTuple.Item2;

		float degrees = item2 * 57.29578f;

		vector.y = Mathf.Lerp(0f, vector.y, num);

		this.currentBaseRotation = Quaternion.Lerp(this.currentBaseRotation, Quaternion.LookRotation(vector.normalized, Vector3.up), Time.deltaTime * num2);
		this.SetHelicopterRotation(this.currentBaseRotation);
		float factor = (!isLanding) ? Mathf.InverseLerp(1f, 0.5f, num) : 1f;
		this.Helicopter.AccelerationTilt(factor);
	}

	// Token: 0x060002B4 RID: 692 RVA: 0x0000B4D8 File Offset: 0x000096D8
	public void BroadcastState()
	{
		if (!this.IsOnlineServer)
		{
			return;
		}
		float rotor = (this.Helicopter == null) ? 0f : this.Helicopter.Rotors.SpeedFactor;
		float ramp = (this.Helicopter == null) ? 0f : this.Helicopter.Ramp.OpenFactor;
		float topRotor = (this.Helicopter == null) ? 0f : this.Helicopter.Rotors.TopRotorAngle;
		float tailRotor = (this.Helicopter == null) ? 0f : this.Helicopter.Rotors.TailRotorAngle;
		ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastHelicopterState(this.State, this.EndingState, this.flightDistance, this.touchdownTimer, rotor, ramp, topRotor, tailRotor);
	}

	// Token: 0x060002B5 RID: 693 RVA: 0x0000B5B1 File Offset: 0x000097B1
	private void ApplySyncDeltas()
	{
		if (this.IsServer)
		{
			return;

		this.syncFlightDistanceDelta *= 0.98f;
	}

	// Token: 0x060002B6 RID: 694 RVA: 0x0000B5E8 File Offset: 0x000097E8
	public void SyncStateClientSide(HelicopterState state, HelicopterTakeoffState takeoffState, float flightDistance, float touchdownTimer, float rotor, float ramp, float topRotor, float tailRotor)
	{
		if (this.IsOnlineServer)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (!ZBMain.instance.mapIsLoaded)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (Mathf.Abs(this.flightDistance - flightDistance) > 50f)
		{
			this.flightDistance = flightDistance;
			this.syncFlightDistanceDelta = 0f;
		}
		else
		{
			this.syncFlightDistanceDelta = flightDistance - this.flightDistance;
		}
		if (Mathf.Abs(this.touchdownTimer - touchdownTimer) > 0.05f)
		{
			this.touchdownTimer = touchdownTimer;
		}
		this.EndingState = takeoffState;
		if (state != this.State && state != HelicopterState.Despawned && this.Helicopter == null)
		{
			this.SpawnHelicopter();
		}
		if (this.Helicopter != null)
		{
			this.Helicopter.Rotors.SyncFactor(rotor);
			this.Helicopter.Ramp.SyncFactor(ramp);
			this.Helicopter.Rotors.SetRotorAngles(topRotor, tailRotor);
		}
		if (state == this.State)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.State = state;
		switch (state)
		{
		case HelicopterState.LandingFlight:
			this.StartLandingFlight();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.TouchDown:
			this.StartTouchdown();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.Spindown:
			this.StartSpindown();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.DeployRamp:
			this.StartDeployRamp();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.RescueAvailable:
			this.StartRescueAvailable();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.SpinupSequence:
			this.StartSpinup();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.TakeoffReady:
			this.StartTakeoffReady();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.FinalChance:
			this.StartFinalChance();
			return;
		case HelicopterState.TakeoffFlight:
			this.StartTakeoffFlight();
			return;
		default:
			return;
		}
	}

	public void ShowObject(InteractableObject interactableObject, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{

			return;

		base.gameObject.SetActive(true);
		ValueTuple<string, Color> textAndColor = this.GetTextAndColor(interactableObject, targetPlayer);
		string item = textAndColor.Item1;
		Color item2 = textAndColor.Item2;

		{
			this.tmpText.text = item;
			this.displayName = item;
			this.tmpText.color = item2;
			this.displayColor = item2;

		{
			this.fillerImage.fillAmount = targetPlayer.arms.interactionTime;
		}
		else
		{
			this.fillerImage.fillAmount = 0f;
		}

		if (vector.z < 0f)
		{
			vector = -vector;
		}
		float num = (float)Screen.width * 0.07f;
		float num2 = (float)Screen.height * 0.05f;
		vector.x = Mathf.Clamp(vector.x, num, (float)Screen.width - num);
		vector.y = Mathf.Clamp(vector.y, 0f, (float)Screen.height - num2);
		base.transform.position = vector;
	}

		{

		}
		if (interactableObject.GetInteractableID() == InteractableObject.ID.Loot)
		{
			return InteractionHUD.GetLootTextAndColor(interactableObject, targetPlayer);

		if (interactableFurniture.state != 3)

		if (interactableFurniture.CanUnlockDoor(targetPlayer))

	private bool CloseToExistingPing(PlayerPinging pinging, Vector3 worldPosition)

		float num = Mathf.Lerp(2.2f, 7f, Mathf.Pow(this.mapRenderer.NormalizedCamSize, 0.333f));

	public void FindHoverSlot()
	{

		if (this.HasHeldItem)
		{
			intVec = ItemsBase.instance.GetItem(this.heldItem.id).Size(this.heldItem.rotated);

		else
		{
			intVec = new IntVec2(1, 1);
		}
		Vector3 pos = this.HasHeldItem ? this.heldItemDisplay.transform.position : Input.mousePosition;
		int index;
		if (this.TryFindHoverIndex(this.equipmentDisplay.weaponrySlots, this.equipmentDisplay.weaponrySlots.Count, pos, out index))
		{
			this.hoverEquipmentIndex = EquipmentIndex.Weapon(index);

		Vector3 referencePosition = this.HasHeldItem ? (this.heldItemDisplay.transform.position - a * 0.5f) : Input.mousePosition;
		IntVec2? hoverSlot = this.storageDisplay.GetHoverSlot(referencePosition);

	// Token: 0x06001AF7 RID: 6903 RVA: 0x000734A4 File Offset: 0x000716A4
	private bool TryFindHoverIndex(List<EquipmentSlot> equipmentSlots, int countMax, Vector3 pos, out int equipmentIndex)
	{
		equipmentIndex = -1;
		if (this.currentSideMenu != InventoryDisplay.SideMenu.Equipment)
		{
			return false;
		}
		int num = 0;
		while (num < equipmentSlots.Count && num < countMax)
		{
			Vector3 vector = UIUtils.ScreenSizeToWorldSize(new Vector3(equipmentSlots[num].RectTransform.rect.width, equipmentSlots[num].RectTransform.rect.height, 0f)) * 0.5f;
			Vector3 vector2 = pos - equipmentSlots[num].transform.position;
			if (Mathf.Abs(vector2.x) < vector.x && Mathf.Abs(vector2.y) < vector.y)
			{
				equipmentIndex = num;
				return true;
			}
			num++;
		}
		return false;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001AF8 RID: 6904 RVA: 0x0007356C File Offset: 0x0007176C
	private void UpdateDetailsDisplay()
	{
		if (!this.heldItem.IsEmpty())
		{
			this.descriptionTimer = 0f;
			return;
		}
		if (this.descriptionTimer <= 1f)
		{
			this.descriptionTimer += Time.deltaTime;
		}
		if (this.lastHoveredItem != this.hoveredItem || this.hoveredItem == null)
		{
			this.descriptionTimer = 0f;
		}
		bool flag = this.descriptionTimer > 0.25f;
		if (flag && this.curSubMenu == InventoryDisplay.SubMenu.None)
		{
			this.SetSubMenu(InventoryDisplay.SubMenu.Details, this.hoveredItem);
			return;
		}
		if (!flag && this.curSubMenu == InventoryDisplay.SubMenu.Details)
		{
			this.ResetSubMenu();
		}
	}

	private InventoryItem FindHoveredItem()

		InventoryDisplay.ContainerType containerType2 = InventoryDisplay.ContainerType.Equipment;
		if (containerType.GetValueOrDefault() == containerType2 & containerType != null)
		{

	public void LeftClickedInventoryItem()

		this.SetHelditem(this.RemoveItemFromHoveredSlot(this.hoveredItem));
		this.EnableHeldItemReturnal(this.hoverContainer.Value, this.hoverEquipmentIndex, this.hoveredItem.rotated);

		{

	// Token: 0x06001B01 RID: 6913 RVA: 0x00073984 File Offset: 0x00071B84
	private void TryQuickEquipHeldItem()
	{
		if (this.currentSideMenu != InventoryDisplay.SideMenu.Equipment)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.heldItem.IsEmpty() || !this.ItemReturnal.canReturn)
		{
			return;
		}
		bool flag = this.ItemReturnal.containerType == InventoryDisplay.ContainerType.Equipment;
		LootPlacingFilter filter = flag ? LootPlacingFilter.Inventory : LootPlacingFilter.Equipment;
		LootTargetPosition lootTargetPosition = this.targetInventory.FindPlaceFor(this.heldItem.id, this.heldItem.stackCount, filter, true);
		if (lootTargetPosition != null)
		{
			this.targetInventory.PutLootIntoPosition(this.heldItem, lootTargetPosition, false);
			this.SetHelditem(InventoryItem.None);
			return;
		}
		if (flag)
		{
			return;
		}
		EquipmentIndex equipmentIndex = InventoryDisplay.OptimalQuickEquipIndex(this.heldItem);
		if (equipmentIndex.Exists)
		{
			InventoryItem item = this.targetInventory.equippedItems.Get(equipmentIndex).Clone();
			this.targetInventory.equippedItems.Set(equipmentIndex, this.heldItem.Clone());
			if (!item.IsEmpty())
			{
				this.targetInventory.AddItem(item, LootPlacingFilter.Both);
			}
			this.SetHelditem(InventoryItem.None);
			this.targetInventory.OnEquipmentChanged();
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001B02 RID: 6914 RVA: 0x00073A90 File Offset: 0x00071C90
	public static EquipmentIndex OptimalQuickEquipIndex(InventoryItem item)
	{
		DatabaseItem.SubType subType = ItemsBase.instance.GetItem(item.id).GetSubType();
		EquipmentSetType equipmentSetType = subType.ToEquipmentSetType();
		if (equipmentSetType == EquipmentSetType.NonEquippable)
		{
			return EquipmentIndex.None;
		}
		if (equipmentSetType == EquipmentSetType.Weapon)
		{
			return EquipmentIndex.Weapon(PlayerEquippedItems.FirstMatchingWeaponIndex(subType.ToWeaponSlotType()));
		}
		return EquipmentIndex.Misc(0);
	}

	public void UnloadContextItemAmmo(InventoryItem contextItem)

		{
			return;

		if (this.targetInventory.ItemExists(contextItem, false))
		{
			this.UnloadGunToInventory(contextItem, this.targetInventory);

		else

			Debug.LogError("Tried context interaction with non existing item! (not an error)");

	// Token: 0x06001B05 RID: 6917 RVA: 0x00073B50 File Offset: 0x00071D50
	public void UnloadGunToInventory(InventoryItem contextItem, PlayerInventory inventory)
	{
		if (contextItem.ammo <= 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		DatabaseGun databaseGun = contextItem.GetDataBaseItem() as DatabaseGun;
		if (databaseGun == null || databaseGun.ammoID == InventoryItem.ID.None)
		{
			return;
		}
		inventory.playerMain.interaction.GotLootFromServer(databaseGun.ammoID, contextItem.ammo);
		contextItem.ammo = 0;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001B06 RID: 6918 RVA: 0x00073BA8 File Offset: 0x00071DA8
	public void SplitStack(InventoryItem contextItem, int extractAmount)
	{
		if (contextItem.IsNone)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (contextItem.GetDataBaseItem().stackMax == 1)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (extractAmount >= contextItem.stackCount)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (extractAmount < 1)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.HasHeldItem)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.targetInventory.ItemExists(contextItem, false))
		{
			InventoryItem inventoryItem = new InventoryItem(contextItem.id);
			inventoryItem.SetGenericNumericValue(extractAmount);
			contextItem.stackCount -= extractAmount;
			this.targetInventory.storage.OnExternalContentManipulation();
			this.SetHelditem(inventoryItem);
			this.ItemReturnal.Disable();
		}
		else
		{
			Debug.LogError("Tried context interaction with non existing item!");
		}
		this.ResetSubMenu();
		this.Show(this.targetInventory);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001B07 RID: 6919 RVA: 0x00073C55 File Offset: 0x00071E55
	public void ClickedOutsideOfInventory()

		{

	// Token: 0x06001B0B RID: 6923 RVA: 0x00073D38 File Offset: 0x00071F38
	public void RecycleContextItem(InventoryItem targetItem)
	{
		if (this.targetInventory.ItemExists(targetItem, false))
		{
			this.UnloadGunToInventory(targetItem, this.targetInventory);
			ScrappingUtils.ScrapItem(targetItem, this.targetInventory);
			this.targetInventory.OnEquipmentChanged();
			AudioController.instance.PlayGlobalFX(AudioController.GlobalFXID.RecycleItem);
			TutorialController.instance.OnScrappedItem();
		}
		else
		{

		this.ResetSubMenu();

		else

	private IEnumerator GetImage(Friend friend)
	{
		Task<Steamworks.Data.Image?> task = SteamFriends.GetSmallAvatarAsync(friend.Id);
		while (!task.IsCompleted)
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		if (this.targetLobby.name.IsNullOrEmpty())

		}
		yield break;
	}

		}
		this.ListenToKey();

	// Token: 0x06001BB2 RID: 7090 RVA: 0x00077248 File Offset: 0x00075448
	private void ListenToKey()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < 510; i++)
		{
			KeyCode keyCode = (KeyCode)i;
			if (!i.ToString().Equals(keyCode.ToString()) && Input.GetKeyDown(keyCode))
			{

				{
					this.controls.SetKeyTo(this.targetKeyID, keyCode);
					return;

				}
			}
		}
	}

using System;

// Token: 0x020001B1 RID: 433
public class LivesDisplay : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000C8B RID: 3211 RVA: 0x00030E50 File Offset: 0x0002F050
	private void Update()
	{
		int num = MatchController.instance.lives - 1;
		if (this.lastShownLives == num)
		{
			return;
		}
		int i;
		for (i = 0; i < num; i++)
		{
			if (this.spawnedHearts.Count <= i)
			{
				Image item = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<Image>(this.heartPrefab, base.transform);
				this.spawnedHearts.Add(item);
			}
			this.spawnedHearts[i].color = this.baseColor;
		}
		while (i < this.spawnedHearts.Count)
		{
			this.spawnedHearts[i].color = this.darkColor;
			i++;
		}
		this.lastShownLives = num;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C8C RID: 3212 RVA: 0x00030EF5 File Offset: 0x0002F0F5
	public void Cleanup()
	{
		this.spawnedHearts.DestroyAndClear<Image>();
		this.lastShownLives = -1;
	}

	{
		int[] loadoutTiers = this.loadoutSelector.GetLoadoutTiers();
		int[] perkTiers = PerkSelection.GetPerkTiers();
		this.LoadoutLevel = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < loadoutTiers.Length; i++)
		{
			this.LoadoutLevel += this.tierScore[loadoutTiers[i]];
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < perkTiers.Length; j++)
		{
			this.LoadoutLevel += this.perkScore[perkTiers[j]];
		}
		this.LoadoutTier = this.CalculateTier(this.LoadoutLevel);
	}

	public int CalculateTier(int level)
	{
		int result = 0;
		int num = 0;
		while (num < this.minimumScore.Length && level >= this.minimumScore[num])
		{
			result = num;
			num++;
		}
		return result;
	}

	public LoadoutSelector.SlotID GetSlotID(LoadoutDescriptor descriptor)

	public void OnChangedSkin()
	{
		int myLobbyID = MultiplayerController.instance.GetMyLobbyID();
		int playerIndex = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerIndex(myLobbyID);
		if (playerIndex < 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer = LobbyController.instance.players[playerIndex];
		lobbyPlayer.skinID = AppearanceSelection.SelectedSkinID;
		lobbyPlayer.skinGender = AppearanceSelection.SelectedGender;
		lobbyPlayer.skinColorSet = AppearanceSelection.GetColors().ToArray<Color>();
		LobbyController.instance.lobbyMenu.slots[playerIndex].UpdateSkin(lobbyPlayer);
		lobbyPlayer.updatedLobbyLoadout = true;
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
		{
			ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadCastSkin(-1, myLobbyID, lobbyPlayer.skinID, lobbyPlayer.skinGender, lobbyPlayer.skinColorSet);
			return;
		}
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
		{
			ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncSkin(myLobbyID, lobbyPlayer.skinID, lobbyPlayer.skinGender, lobbyPlayer.skinColorSet);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600038E RID: 910 RVA: 0x0000E31C File Offset: 0x0000C51C
	public void ApplyLoadoutToLobby()
	{
		int myLobbyID = MultiplayerController.instance.GetMyLobbyID();
		int playerIndex = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerIndex(myLobbyID);
		if (playerIndex < 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		LobbyPlayer playerByLobbyID = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerByLobbyID(myLobbyID);
		InventoryItem.ID[] items = new InventoryItem.ID[]
		{
			this.GetItem(LoadoutSelector.SlotID.Primary),
			InventoryItem.ID.None,
			this.GetItem(LoadoutSelector.SlotID.Secondary),
			this.GetItem(LoadoutSelector.SlotID.Melee)
		};
		LobbyController.instance.players[playerIndex].loadoutLevel = this.LoadoutLevel;
		LobbyController.instance.lobbyMenu.slots[playerIndex].UpdateWithLoadout(playerByLobbyID, this.LoadoutLevel, items);
		LobbyController.instance.players[playerIndex].updatedLobbyLoadout = true;
		this.lastLobbyLoadout = items;
		this.SyncLobbyLoadout();
	}

	// Token: 0x0600038F RID: 911 RVA: 0x0000E3D8 File Offset: 0x0000C5D8
	public void SyncLobbyLoadout()
	{
		int myLobbyID = MultiplayerController.instance.GetMyLobbyID();
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
		{
			ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastLobbyLoadout(-1, myLobbyID, this.LoadoutLevel, this.lastLobbyLoadout, PerkSelection.GetSyncList());
			return;
		}
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsClient())
		{
			ClientController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncLobbyLoadout(myLobbyID, this.LoadoutLevel, this.lastLobbyLoadout, PerkSelection.GetSyncList());
		}

	public LoadoutDescriptor[] AllLoadoutsOfTier(int tierNumber, bool ignorePriceLocked = false)
	{
		if (!this.allLoadoutsPerTierDictionary.ContainsKey(tierNumber))
		{
			List<LoadoutDescriptor> allDescriptors = LoadoutDatabase.Instance.AllDescriptors;
			LoadoutDescriptor[] value = ignorePriceLocked ? (from x in allDescriptors
			where x.TierNumber == tierNumber && !Pricing.IsBlocked(x)
			select x).ToArray<LoadoutDescriptor>() : (from x in allDescriptors
			where x.TierNumber == tierNumber

	}

	// Token: 0x0600039A RID: 922 RVA: 0x0000E794 File Offset: 0x0000C994
	public void DistributeLoadoutUnlock(Zombie zombie, List<int> killerLobbyIDs)
	{
		ZombieType type = zombie.identity.type;
		int bossTier = BossfightController.instance.GetBossTier(type);
		foreach (int lobbyID in killerLobbyIDs)
		{
			LobbyPlayer playerByLobbyID = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerByLobbyID(lobbyID);
			if (playerByLobbyID.type == LobbyPlayer.Type.Host)
			{
				TutorialController.instance.OnKilledBoss(type);
				this.TryUnlockRandomLoadout(bossTier);
			}
			else
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncUnlockLoadout(bossTier, playerByLobbyID.connection.ConnectionID);
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncKillBoss(playerByLobbyID.connection.ConnectionID, type);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600039B RID: 923 RVA: 0x0000E858 File Offset: 0x0000CA58
	public void TryUnlockRandomLoadout(int tier)
	{
		if (GameModeSelection.LoadoutTierCap() < tier)
		{
			PlayerHUD.instance.genericPopup.StartDisplay(GenericHudPopupMessageID.NoLoadoutsInThisMode, -1);
			return;
		}
		List<LoadoutDescriptor> list = this.AllAvailableLoadouts(tier, true);
		if (list.Count == 0)
		{
			PlayerHUD.instance.genericPopup.StartDisplay(GenericHudPopupMessageID.NoMoreLoadoutsForBoss, -1);
			return;
		}
		List<LoadoutDescriptor> list2 = this.AllLoadoutsOfTier(tier, false).ToList<LoadoutDescriptor>();
		this.RemoveChallengeOnlyLoadouts(list2);
		if (list.Count == list2.Count)
		{
			List<LoadoutDescriptor> list3 = this.SelectPrimaries(list);
			if (list3.Count > 0)
			{
				list = list3;
			}
			else
			{
				Debug.LogError("No primaries to unlock on tier " + tier.ToString() + " ???");
			}
		}
		LoadoutDescriptor random = list.GetRandom(Randomizer.Unity);
		this.UnlockLoadout(random);
		PersistenceController.instance.QueueSave(PersistenceController.FileID.ProgressFile);
		if (!Settings.General.AutoSkipLoadoutAnimations && MenuController.instance.curMenuID != BaseMenu.ID.GameOver)
		{
			this.ShowAnimationScreen();
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600039C RID: 924 RVA: 0x0000E934 File Offset: 0x0000CB34
	private void RemoveChallengeOnlyLoadouts(List<LoadoutDescriptor> loadoutsAvailable)
	{
		foreach (LoadoutID id in Challenges.Instance.ChallengeOnlyLoadouts)
		{
			LoadoutDescriptor descriptor = LoadoutDatabase.Instance.GetDescriptor(id);
			loadoutsAvailable.Remove(descriptor);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600039D RID: 925 RVA: 0x0000E998 File Offset: 0x0000CB98
	public void UnlockLoadout(LoadoutID loadoutID)

	}

	// Token: 0x0600039E RID: 926 RVA: 0x0000E9AC File Offset: 0x0000CBAC
	private void UnlockLoadout(LoadoutDescriptor loadout)
	{
		if (!LoadoutSelector.instance.IsLocked(loadout))
		{
			return;
		}
		LoadoutSelector.instance.unlockedLoadouts.Add(loadout.LoadoutID);
		MatchStatsTracking.AddLoadoutUnlock(loadout.LoadoutID);
		this.RegisterOnAnimationScreen(loadout);
		if (!MatchController.EffectivellyGameOver)
		{
			LootNotifier.Instance.AddLoadoutNotification(loadout);
		}
		SkinLoadoutDescriptor skinLoadoutDescriptor = loadout as SkinLoadoutDescriptor;
		if (skinLoadoutDescriptor != null && skinLoadoutDescriptor.RelatedPerkLoadout != null)
		{
			this.UnlockLoadout(skinLoadoutDescriptor.RelatedPerkLoadout);
			return;
		}
		PerkLoadoutDescriptor perkLoadoutDescriptor = loadout as PerkLoadoutDescriptor;
		SkinLoadoutDescriptor loadout2;
		if (perkLoadoutDescriptor != null && this.TryFindRelatedSkin(perkLoadoutDescriptor, out loadout2))
		{
			this.UnlockLoadout(loadout2);
			return;
		}
		LoadoutSelector.instance.ListOptions();
		PerkSelectionMenu.instance.RefreshAll();
	}

	// Token: 0x0600039F RID: 927 RVA: 0x0000EA58 File Offset: 0x0000CC58
	private bool TryFindRelatedSkin(PerkLoadoutDescriptor perkLoadout, out SkinLoadoutDescriptor skinLoadout)
	{
		skinLoadout = LoadoutDatabase.Instance.GetSkins().FirstOrDefault((SkinLoadoutDescriptor x) => x.RelatedPerkLoadout == perkLoadout);
		return skinLoadout != null;
	}

	// Token: 0x060003A0 RID: 928 RVA: 0x0000EA97 File Offset: 0x0000CC97
	public void RegisterOnAnimationScreen(LoadoutDescriptor loadout)
	{

	// Token: 0x060003A1 RID: 929 RVA: 0x0000EAA5 File Offset: 0x0000CCA5
	public void ShowAnimationScreen()
	{
		this.menu.StartDisplay();
		if (MenuController.instance.curMenuID != BaseMenu.ID.LoadoutUnlocked)
		{
			MenuController.instance.SetReturnMenu();
		}
		MenuController.instance.GoToMenu(BaseMenu.ID.LoadoutUnlocked);

	}

	// Token: 0x060003A2 RID: 930 RVA: 0x0000EAE4 File Offset: 0x0000CCE4
	public List<LoadoutDescriptor> AllAvailableLoadouts(int tier, bool excludeChallengeLoadouts = true)
	{
		List<LoadoutDescriptor> list = new List<LoadoutDescriptor>();
		foreach (LoadoutDescriptor loadoutDescriptor in this.AllLoadoutsOfTier(tier, false))
		{
			if (!Pricing.IsBlocked(loadoutDescriptor) && !MatchController.instance.loadoutSelector.unlockedLoadouts.Contains(loadoutDescriptor.LoadoutID))
			{
				list.Add(loadoutDescriptor);
			}
		}
		if (excludeChallengeLoadouts)
		{
			this.RemoveChallengeOnlyLoadouts(list);
		}
		return list;
	}

	// Token: 0x060003A3 RID: 931 RVA: 0x0000EB48 File Offset: 0x0000CD48
	public List<LoadoutDescriptor> SelectPrimaries(List<LoadoutDescriptor> loadoutsList)
	{

		for (int i = 0; i < loadoutsList.Count; i++)
		{
			EquipmentLoadoutDescriptor equipmentLoadoutDescriptor = loadoutsList[i] as EquipmentLoadoutDescriptor;
			if (equipmentLoadoutDescriptor != null && ItemsBase.instance.GetItem(equipmentLoadoutDescriptor.EquipmentID).GetSubType() == DatabaseItem.SubType.PrimaryGun)
			{
				list.Add(loadoutsList[i]);
			}
		}
		return list;
	}

	public bool IsRepeatedPlayer(SteamId steamID, LobbyPlayer.Type playerType)
	{
		if (!MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
		{
			throw new Exception("Should never call this if not Hosting an online server.");
		}
		SteamId mySteamID = SteamController.instance.MySteamID;
		foreach (LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer in this.players)
		{
			bool flag = ((lobbyPlayer.connection != null) ? lobbyPlayer.connection.SteamID : mySteamID).Equals(steamID);
			bool flag2 = lobbyPlayer.type.Equals(playerType);
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!DebugController.DebugEnabled)

	// Token: 0x06001642 RID: 5698 RVA: 0x00061088 File Offset: 0x0005F288
	public int AddPlayer(SteamP2PConnection connection, string playerName, SkinID skinID, Gender skinGender, Color[] skinColorSet, int loadoutLevel, bool applyLoadout)
	{
		int num = this.PullID();
		byte colorCode = this.PullPlayerColor();
		LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer = new LobbyPlayer
		{
			lobbyID = num,
			colorCode = colorCode,
			skinID = skinID,
			skinGender = skinGender,
			skinColorSet = skinColorSet,
			loadoutLevel = loadoutLevel,
			connection = connection,
			type = ((connection == null) ? LobbyPlayer.Type.Host : LobbyPlayer.Type.Client),
			playerName = playerName
		};
		lobbyPlayer.SetReady(lobbyPlayer.type == LobbyPlayer.Type.Host);
		this.players.Add(lobbyPlayer);
		Action playersChanged = this.PlayersChanged;
		if (playersChanged != null)
		{
			playersChanged();
		}
		this.lobbyMenu.UpdateAllSlots();
		LobbyPlayersManagementMenu.Refresh();
		if (applyLoadout)
		{
			LoadoutSelector.instance.ApplyLoadoutToLobby();
		}
		this.TreatReconnectingPlayer(lobbyPlayer);
		return num;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001643 RID: 5699 RVA: 0x00061144 File Offset: 0x0005F344
	private void TreatReconnectingPlayer(LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer)
	{
		if (lobbyPlayer.type == LobbyPlayer.Type.Host)
		{
			return;
		}
		SteamId steamID = lobbyPlayer.connection.SteamID;
		DisconnectedSteamPlayer disconnectedSteamPlayer = this.disconnectedSteamPlayers.Find((DisconnectedSteamPlayer player) => player.IsSamePlayer(steamID));
		if (disconnectedSteamPlayer == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.disconnectedSteamPlayers.Remove(disconnectedSteamPlayer);
		LootSacksController.Instance.TransferSackReservations(disconnectedSteamPlayer.PreviousLobbyID, lobbyPlayer.lobbyID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001644 RID: 5700 RVA: 0x000611B0 File Offset: 0x0005F3B0
	public void RemovePlayer(int index)
	{
		int lobbyID = this.players[index].lobbyID;
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
		{
			LootSacksController.Instance.ClearPendingPacketsFromDisconnectedPlayer(lobbyID);
			LootSacksController.Instance.ReduceReservationTimeForDisconnectedPlayer(lobbyID);
			this.AddDisconnectedPlayer(this.players[index]);
		}
		this.players.RemoveAt(index);
		this.lobbyMenu.UpdateAllSlots();
		LoadoutSelector.instance.ApplyLoadoutToLobby();
		TextChat.instance.OnLobbyPlayerRemoved();
		LobbyPlayersManagementMenu.Refresh();
		Action playersChanged = this.PlayersChanged;
		if (playersChanged != null)
		{
			playersChanged();
		}
		ThrowableController.instance.OnPlayerRemoval(lobbyID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001645 RID: 5701 RVA: 0x0006124F File Offset: 0x0005F44F
	private void AddDisconnectedPlayer(LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer)

	}

	public void OnSyncLobbyLoadout(int lobbyID, int loadoutLevel, InventoryItem.ID[] items, List<PerkID> perks)
	{
		LobbyController lobbyController = LobbyController.instance;
		int playerIndex = lobbyController.GetPlayerIndex(lobbyID);
		if (playerIndex < 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (!this.slots.HasIndex(playerIndex))
		{
			return;
		}
		lobbyController.players[playerIndex].loadoutLevel = loadoutLevel;
		lobbyController.players[playerIndex].perks = perks;
		LobbyPlayer playerByLobbyID = lobbyController.GetPlayerByLobbyID(lobbyID);
		this.slots[playerIndex].UpdateWithLoadout(playerByLobbyID, loadoutLevel, items);
		lobbyController.players[playerIndex].updatedLobbyLoadout = true;
	}

		if (num == 0 || lootCategory.Empty)
		{
			return null;

		List<DroppedLoot> list = new List<DroppedLoot>();
		for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)

			if (!Pricing.IsBlocked(inventoryItem.id))
			{
				DroppedLoot droppedLoot = LootSpawner.SpawnPublicLootServerSide(cluster.RandomPosition(), inventoryItem);
				if (!(droppedLoot == null))
				{
					list.Add(droppedLoot);

			}
		}
		return list;

	// Token: 0x06001393 RID: 5011 RVA: 0x00057CB4 File Offset: 0x00055EB4
	private static int LootCountForCluster(LootSpawnCluster cluster, int roomCount)
	{
		int num = cluster.ClusterType.LootCount();
		if (num == 0)
		{
			return 0;
		}
		float num2 = (float)num;
		num2 = UnityEngine.Random.Range(num2 * 0.7f, num2 * 1.3f);
		if (cluster.BuildingType == Polygon.ContentType.Residence)
		{
			num2 *= Mathf.Lerp(0.5f, 1.5f, Mathf.InverseLerp(6f, 18f, (float)roomCount));
		}
		int num3 = Mathf.RoundToInt(num2);
		if (num3 < 1)
		{
			num3 = 1;
		}
		return num3;
	}

		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < instance.width; i++)

			for (int j = 0; j < instance.height; j++)

					bool flag = num % this.lodSplitCount != this.curLodIndex;
					num++;
					if (!flag)
					{
						this.LodForCell(loot3dDistSqr, position, lodPlayer, cell);
					}
				}

	// Token: 0x0600139A RID: 5018 RVA: 0x00057FDC File Offset: 0x000561DC
	private void LodForCell(float loot3dDistSqr, Vector3 lodPos, PlayerMain lodPlayer, HashCell cell)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < cell.loot.Count; i++)
		{
			DroppedLoot droppedLoot = cell.loot[i];
			Vector3 position = droppedLoot.transform.position;
			float num = Vector3.SqrMagnitude(position - lodPos);
			bool flag = num < loot3dDistSqr;
			droppedLoot.SetRendering(flag);
			if (flag && lodPlayer && lodPlayer.HasLocalControl && LootController.LootLootable(lodPlayer, position, num))
			{

	// Token: 0x0600139B RID: 5019 RVA: 0x00058060 File Offset: 0x00056260
	public static bool LootLootable(PlayerMain player, Vector3 lootPos, float distanceSqr)
	{
		if (distanceSqr >= LootController.Instance.lootInteractDistance * LootController.Instance.lootInteractDistance)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (player.cam.CurrentMode != PlayerCamera.Mode.FirstPerson)
		{
			return true;
		}
		Vector3 vector = MainCamera.instance.cam.WorldToViewportPoint(lootPos);
		return vector.x > 0f && vector.x < 1f && vector.y > 0f && vector.y < 1f && vector.z > 0f;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001212 RID: 4626 RVA: 0x0004CCDC File Offset: 0x0004AEDC
	private void GenerateEdgeRoadMesh(GridEdge edge)
	{
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.Lerp(edge.node3d[0], edge.node3d[3], this.sidewalkProportion);
		Vector3 vector2 = Vector3.Lerp(edge.node3d[1], edge.node3d[2], this.sidewalkProportion);
		Vector3 vector3 = Vector3.Lerp(edge.node3d[2], edge.node3d[1], this.sidewalkProportion);

		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleElevated(vector2, vector, edge.node3d[0], 13, this.sidewalkHeight);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(vector + b, vector2 + b, vector2, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(vector + b, vector2, vector, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(edge.node3d[1] + b, edge.node3d[0] + b, edge.node3d[0], 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(edge.node3d[0], edge.node3d[1], edge.node3d[1] + b, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleElevated(vector4, vector3, edge.node3d[2], 13, this.sidewalkHeight);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleElevated(edge.node3d[2], edge.node3d[3], vector4, 13, this.sidewalkHeight);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(vector3 + b, vector4 + b, vector4, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(vector4, vector3, vector3 + b, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(edge.node3d[3] + b, edge.node3d[2] + b, edge.node3d[2], 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(edge.node3d[2], edge.node3d[3], edge.node3d[3] + b, 13);
		this.AddTeleportPointsOnArea(9, 3, 1, 1, 5f, vector, vector2, vector4, vector3);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001213 RID: 4627 RVA: 0x0004CFB4 File Offset: 0x0004B1B4
	private void ConstructBeach(GridEdge edge)
	{
		if (!edge.IsCoast())
		{
			return;
		}
		List<Vector3> beachPoints = this.mapGen.nodes[edge.edgeStart.x, edge.edgeStart.y].beachPoints;
		List<Vector3> beachPoints2 = this.mapGen.nodes[edge.edgeEnd.x, edge.edgeEnd.y].beachPoints;
		for (int i = 0; i < beachPoints.Count - 1; i++)
		{

			Vector3 vector2 = beachPoints2[i];
			Vector3 v = beachPoints2[i + 1];
			Vector3 vector3 = beachPoints2[i + 1];
			Vector3 vector4 = beachPoints[i + 1];
			Vector3 v2 = beachPoints[i];
			if (edge.beachIsToTheLeft)
			{
				this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleCCW(vector, vector2, v, 10);
				this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleCCW(vector3, vector4, v2, 10);

			else

				this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(vector3, vector4, v2, 10);
			}
			if (i == 0)
