	// Token: 0x06001217 RID: 4631 RVA: 0x0004D1A8 File Offset: 0x0004B3A8
	private void ConstructRoadCorner(GridNode node)
	{
		if (node.neigRoads.Count < 3)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 vector = Vector3.zero;
		foreach (NodeAndAngle nodeAndAngle in node.roadPoints)
		{
			vector += nodeAndAngle.point;
		}
		vector /= (float)node.roadPoints.Count;
		for (int i = 0; i < node.roadPoints.Count; i++)
		{
			NodeAndAngle nodeAndAngle2 = node.roadPoints[i];
			nodeAndAngle2.angle = Mathf.Atan2(vector.x - nodeAndAngle2.point.x, vector.z - nodeAndAngle2.point.z);
			node.roadPoints[i] = nodeAndAngle2;
		}
		node.roadPoints.Sort((NodeAndAngle a, NodeAndAngle b) => a.angle.CompareTo(b.angle));
		if (node.roadPoints.Count < 3)
		{
			Debug.LogError("Road has < 3 points");
		}
		for (int j = 1; j < node.roadPoints.Count - 1; j++)
		{
			this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(node.roadPoints[0].point, node.roadPoints[j].point, node.roadPoints[j + 1].point, 12);
		}
		this.AddTeleportPointAtRoadCorner(5f, vector, node.roadPoints);
		for (int k = 0; k < node.roadPoints.Count; k++)
		{
			int num = k - 1;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = node.roadPoints.Count - 1;
			}
			int num2 = k + 1;
			if (num2 > node.roadPoints.Count - 1)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			Vector3 point = node.roadPoints[k].point;
			Vector3 vector2 = Vector3.Lerp(point, node.roadPoints[num].point, this.sidewalkProportion);
			Vector3 vector3 = Vector3.Lerp(point, node.roadPoints[num2].point, this.sidewalkProportion);
			Vector3 vector4 = (vector2 + vector3) * 0.5f;
			if (Vector3.Distance(vector4, point) < this.sidewalkProportion * this.mapGen.sizeSettings.roadWidth * 0.75f)
			{
				Vector3 vector5 = vector2 - point + (vector3 - point);
				float d = ((vector2 - point).magnitude + (vector3 - point).magnitude) * 0.45f;
				vector4 = point + vector5.normalized * d;
				this.MakeSidewalkCorner(point, vector2, vector4);
				this.MakeSidewalkCorner(point, vector4, vector3);
			}
			else
			{
				this.MakeSidewalkCorner(point, vector2, vector3);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001218 RID: 4632 RVA: 0x0004D4AC File Offset: 0x0004B6AC
	private void MakeSidewalkCorner(Vector3 curPoint, Vector3 prevPoint, Vector3 nextPoint)
	{
		Vector3 b = Vector3.up * this.sidewalkHeight;
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangleElevated(curPoint, nextPoint, prevPoint, 13, this.sidewalkHeight);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(prevPoint + b, nextPoint + b, nextPoint, 13);
		this.curMeshGen.PushTriangle(nextPoint, prevPoint, prevPoint + b, 13);
	}

	// Token: 0x060012BD RID: 4797 RVA: 0x000537E0 File Offset: 0x000519E0
	public void CreateHash(float extX, float extZ, List<Polygon> allPolys, List<GridEdge> allEdges, MapGeneration mapGen)
	{

		this.height = Mathf.CeilToInt(extZ / this.cellSize);

			HashCell cell = this.GetCell(pos);
			cell.polygons.Add(polygon);

			{
				cell.allBuildings.Add(polygon.building);
			}
		}
		foreach (GridEdge gridEdge in allEdges)
		{
			if (gridEdge.roadType == GridEdge.RoadType.SingleLane)
			{
				this.GetCell(gridEdge.center).edges.Add(gridEdge);
			}
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < mapGen.sizeSettings.gridW; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < mapGen.sizeSettings.gridH; j++)

				if (mapGen.nodes[i, j].hasRoad)
				{
					this.GetCell(mapGen.nodes[i, j].pos3d).nodes.Add(mapGen.nodes[i, j]);
				}
			}
		}
		for (int k = 0; k < this.width; k++)
		{
			for (int l = 0; l < this.height; l++)
			{
				this.cells[k, l].collisionActive = false;
			}
		}

	// Token: 0x060012BF RID: 4799 RVA: 0x000539DC File Offset: 0x00051BDC
	private void InternalGenerateCell(HashCell cell)
	{
		cell.generated = HashCell.Generated.Ongoing;
		if (cell.hasContent)
		{
			if (this.genTerrainMesh)
			{
				MapConstructor.instance.GenerateHashCellMesh(cell);
			}
			if (this.genBuildingMesh)
			{
				LotConstructor.instance.GenerateHashCellBuildings(cell);
			}
			if (cell.polygons.Count > 0)
			{
				LootController.Instance.GenerateAllLootForCell(cell);
			}
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
			{
				cell.dataBuffers = new HashCellDataBuffers();
				cell.dataBuffers.GenerateBuffers(cell);
			}
		}
		cell.generated = HashCell.Generated.Done;
		MapRendering.instance.CellGenerated(cell);
		GlobalInteractionController.instance.OnCellGenerated(cell);
	}

	// Token: 0x060012C0 RID: 4800 RVA: 0x00053A78 File Offset: 0x00051C78
	public void OnDrawGizmos()

		for (int i = 0; i <= this.width; i++)
		{

			Vector3 to = new Vector3((float)i * this.cellSize, 30f, (float)this.height * this.cellSize);

		for (int j = 0; j <= this.height; j++)

			Vector3 from2 = new Vector3(0f, 30f, (float)j * this.cellSize);
			Vector3 to2 = new Vector3((float)this.width * this.cellSize, 30f, (float)j * this.cellSize);
			Gizmos.DrawLine(from2, to2);
		}
		if (this.drawCellsCollision)
		{
			for (int k = 0; k < this.width; k++)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < this.height; l++)
				{
					Gizmos.color = (this.cells[k, l].collisionActive ? Color.green : Color.red);
					if (!this.cells[k, l].hasContent)

			return;

		if (this.drawCellsGen)
		{
			for (int m = 0; m < this.width; m++)

					Vector3 center = this.GetCellCenter(new IntVec2(m, n)).x0y(40f);

					{
						Gizmos.color = Color.yellow;
					}
					else if (this.cells[m, n].generated == HashCell.Generated.Done)
					{
						Gizmos.color = Color.green;
					}
					else if (this.cells[m, n].generated == HashCell.Generated.Not)
					{
						Gizmos.color = Color.black;

					Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(center, this.cellSize * 0.4f);
					Gizmos.color = (this.cells[m, n].hasContent ? Color.white : Color.black);
					Gizmos.DrawWireSphere(center, this.cellSize * 0.3f);
				}

	}

	private void SpawnRequired()
	{

					Color playerColor = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerColor(lobbyPlayer.colorCode);

					component.SetVisible(playerObj.pinging.PingPosition.exists);
					this.markers.Add(lobbyPlayer.lobbyID, component);
				}

		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000D71 RID: 3441 RVA: 0x00034688 File Offset: 0x00032888
	public void CellGenerated(HashCell cell)
	{
		if (this.gapMeshObject == null)
		{

		if (terrainMesh == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		GameObject gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(this.mapCellTerrainPrefab, terrainMesh.transform.position + Vector3.up * 100f, terrainMesh.transform.rotation, base.transform);

		GameObject gameObject2 = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(this.mapCellBuildingPrefab, terrainMesh.transform.position + Vector3.up * 105f, terrainMesh.transform.rotation, base.transform);
		MeshFilter component = gameObject2.GetComponent<MeshFilter>();
		GenericMeshGenerator genericMeshGenerator = new GenericMeshGenerator();
		genericMeshGenerator.StartMeshCreation(8);
		for (int i = 0; i < cell.polygons.Count; i++)
		{
			if (cell.polygons[i].HasBuilding)
			{
				BuildingBlueprint building = cell.polygons[i].building;
				for (int j = 0; j < building.foundation.Count; j++)
				{
					Vector3 gridCellStart = building.GetGridCellStart(building.foundation[j].bottomLeft.x, building.foundation[j].bottomLeft.y, 0);
					Vector3 gridCellStart2 = building.GetGridCellStart(building.foundation[j].bottomLeft.x, building.foundation[j].topRight.y + 1, 0);
					Vector3 gridCellStart3 = building.GetGridCellStart(building.foundation[j].topRight.x + 1, building.foundation[j].topRight.y + 1, 0);
					Vector3 gridCellStart4 = building.GetGridCellStart(building.foundation[j].topRight.x + 1, building.foundation[j].bottomLeft.y, 0);
					genericMeshGenerator.PushQuad(gridCellStart, gridCellStart2, gridCellStart3, gridCellStart4, 0);
				}
			}
		}
		Mesh mesh = new Mesh();
		component.mesh = mesh;
		genericMeshGenerator.FinalizeMesh(mesh, cell.cellCenter, false, false);
		this.renderArray[cell.coordinate.x, cell.coordinate.y].buildingObject = gameObject2;
	}

		public PathingOrder GetPathingOrder(EntityLocation fromEntityLocation, bool fatZombie, long targetID)
		{
			if (targetID < 0L)
			{

				return PathingOrder.StayOrder;

			PathfindingLocation fromLocation = PathfindingLocation.Convert(fromEntityLocation);
			PathRequest request = new PathRequest(fromLocation, fatZombie);
			PathToTargetHistory historyFor = this.GetHistoryFor((uint)targetID);
			PathingOrder? path = historyFor.GetPath(request, fromEntityLocation.pos3d);
			bool flag = path != null;

			{

		}

		public void ProcessNewRequests()

		private void ProcessNewRequests(PathToTargetHistory history)

using System;

// Token: 0x020000A0 RID: 160
public class PerkOptionsPanel : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x0600040F RID: 1039 RVA: 0x0000F630 File Offset: 0x0000D830
	public void Clear()
	{
		foreach (PerkOptionSlot perkOptionSlot in this.spawnedSlots)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(perkOptionSlot.gameObject);
		}
		this.spawnedSlots.Clear();
		foreach (GameObject obj in this.spawnedEmpties)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(obj);
		}
		this.spawnedEmpties.Clear();
	}

	// Token: 0x06000410 RID: 1040 RVA: 0x0000F6DC File Offset: 0x0000D8DC
	public void PopulateWithOptions()
	{
		List<PerkLoadoutDescriptor> list = LoadoutDatabase.Instance.GetPerks().ToList<PerkLoadoutDescriptor>();
		list.Sort((PerkLoadoutDescriptor a, PerkLoadoutDescriptor b) => a.Tier.CompareTo(b.Tier));
		this.Populate(list);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000411 RID: 1041 RVA: 0x0000F728 File Offset: 0x0000D928
	public void PopulateWithSelected(IEnumerable<PerkID> selectedPerks, int maxPerks)
	{
		List<PerkLoadoutDescriptor> list = (from perkID in selectedPerks
		select LoadoutDatabase.Instance.FindPerkLoadout(perkID)).ToList<PerkLoadoutDescriptor>();
		list.Sort((PerkLoadoutDescriptor a, PerkLoadoutDescriptor b) => a.Tier.CompareTo(b.Tier));
		this.Populate(list);
		this.AddEmptySlots(maxPerks - list.Count);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000412 RID: 1042 RVA: 0x0000F79C File Offset: 0x0000D99C
	private void AddEmptySlots(int emptySlotsCount)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < emptySlotsCount; i++)
		{
			GameObject item = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(this.emptyPrefab, base.transform);
			this.spawnedEmpties.Add(item);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000413 RID: 1043 RVA: 0x0000F7D4 File Offset: 0x0000D9D4
	private void Populate(IEnumerable<PerkLoadoutDescriptor> perks)
	{
		this.Clear();
		foreach (PerkLoadoutDescriptor perkLoadoutDescriptor in perks)
		{
			PerkOptionSlot perkOptionSlot = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<PerkOptionSlot>(this.slotPrefab, base.transform);
			bool locked = LoadoutSelector.instance.IsLocked(perkLoadoutDescriptor) || Pricing.IsBlocked(perkLoadoutDescriptor.PerkDescriptor.ID);
			perkOptionSlot.Show(perkLoadoutDescriptor, locked);
			perkOptionSlot.SetSelectAction(new Action<PerkID>(this.SelectedPerk));
			this.spawnedSlots.Add(perkOptionSlot);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000414 RID: 1044 RVA: 0x0000F874 File Offset: 0x0000DA74
	private void SelectedPerk(PerkID perkId)
	{

	}

	public void LoadProgression()
	{
		string json;

		SaveProgress saveProgress = new SaveProgress();
		bool flag = false;
		try
		{
			saveProgress = JsonUtility.FromJson<SaveProgress>(json);
			flag = this.VerifyProgressLoad(saveProgress);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Error converting JSON 'saveProgress' file", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			loadResult = PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;

		if (loadResult != PersistenceController.LoadResult.Success || !flag)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Couldnt load ProgressFile > " + loadResult.ToString(), LogSource.IO);
			Currency.Instance.EnsureDefaultValues();
			this.QueueSave(PersistenceController.FileID.ProgressFile);
			TutorialController.instance.SetTutorialStage(0, -1);
			MatchController.instance.loadoutSelector.ResetPreferredLoadoutAndSkin();
			MatchController.instance.loadoutSelector.SetUnlockedLoadouts(new List<LoadoutID>());
			return;
		}
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Loaded ProgressFile > " + loadResult.ToString(), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Success, false);
		TutorialController.instance.SetTutorialStage(saveProgress.tutorialProgressV2, saveProgress.tutorialVersion);
		Challenges.Instance.LoadCompleted(saveProgress.completedChallenges);
		Challenges.Instance.LoadFailedAchievments(saveProgress.failedAchievments);
		ChallengesTracking.LoadTrackedKills(saveProgress.trackedZombieKills);
		MatchController.instance.loadoutSelector.SetUnlockedLoadouts(saveProgress.unlockedLoadout);
		MatchController.instance.loadoutSelector.LoadPreferredLoadoutAndSkin(saveProgress);
		Currency.Instance.SetCurrencyFromSaveFile(saveProgress);
		Challenges.Instance.EnsureLoadoutRewards();
	}

	// Token: 0x060018D3 RID: 6355 RVA: 0x0006A1D4 File Offset: 0x000683D4

	// Token: 0x060018DF RID: 6367 RVA: 0x0006A8D8 File Offset: 0x00068AD8
	public void SaveFile(PersistenceController.FileID id)
	{
		if (!this.functional)

			DeveloperConsole.Log("Cant save " + id.ToString() + ". Persistence is disabled.", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, true);

		}
		string filePath = this.GetFilePath(id);
		string fileJson = this.GetFileJson(id);
		try
		{

			{

			ChallengesTracking.OnFileSaved(id);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Couldnt save file {0}!", id), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, true);
			return;
		}
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Saved " + id.ToString(), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Success, false);

		{

	// Token: 0x060018E0 RID: 6368 RVA: 0x0006A9D8 File Offset: 0x00068BD8
	public PersistenceController.LoadResult LoadFile(PersistenceController.FileID id, out string res)
	{
		res = "";
		if (!this.functional)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Cant load " + id.ToString() + ". Persistence is disabled.", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		string filePath = this.GetFilePath(id);
		string path = filePath + this.fileExtension;
		string path2 = filePath + this.securityExtension;
		string text;
		string json;
		try
		{
			text = File.ReadAllText(path, PersistenceController.DefaultEncoding);
			json = File.ReadAllText(path2, PersistenceController.DefaultEncoding);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Error loading file {0}", id), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		SaveSecurityData saveSecurityData;
		try
		{
			saveSecurityData = JsonUtility.FromJson<SaveSecurityData>(json);
		}
		catch
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Exception converting JSON Save file" + id.ToString(), LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CantLoad;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData == null)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (1).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash == null)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (2).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash.Length != 32)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security for " + id.ToString() + " couldnt be loaded (3).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.CorruptedSecurity;
		}
		byte[] securityHash = this.security.GetSecurityHash(text);
		if (saveSecurityData.saveHash.Length != securityHash.Length)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Security mismatch " + id.ToString() + " (1).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return PersistenceController.LoadResult.SecurityMismatch;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < securityHash.Length; i++)
		{
			if (saveSecurityData.saveHash[i] != securityHash[i])
			{
				DeveloperConsole.Log("Security mismatch " + id.ToString() + " (2).", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
				return PersistenceController.LoadResult.SecurityMismatch;
			}
		}
		res = text;
		return PersistenceController.LoadResult.Success;
	}

	// Token: 0x060008C9 RID: 2249 RVA: 0x00021BE4 File Offset: 0x0001FDE4
	private void CalculateVectors()
	{
		Quaternion quaternion = Quaternion.AngleAxis(this.RotationAngle, Vector3.up);
		Quaternion rhs = Quaternion.AngleAxis(-this.ElevationAngle, Vector3.right);
		this.forwardVector = quaternion * Vector3.forward;
		this.rightVector = Vector3.Cross(Vector3.up, this.forwardVector);
		this.lookVector = quaternion * rhs * Vector3.forward;
	}

	// Token: 0x060008CA RID: 2250 RVA: 0x00021C54 File Offset: 0x0001FE54
	private void ControlCamera()
	{
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.W))
		{
			this.Position += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * this.forwardVector;
		}
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.S))
		{
			this.Position -= Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * this.forwardVector;
		}
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D))
		{
			this.Position += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * this.rightVector;
		}
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A))
		{
			this.Position -= Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * this.rightVector;
		}
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space))
		{
			this.Position += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * Vector3.up;
		}
		if (Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftControl))
		{
			this.Position -= Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.translateSpeed * Vector3.up;
		}
		if (!ZBMain.InNormalCanvasMode)
		{
			this.RotationAngle += Input.GetAxis("Mouse X") * ControlsMenu.instance.controls.AdaptedSensitivity;
			this.ElevationAngle += Input.GetAxis("Mouse Y") * 1.5f * ControlsMenu.instance.controls.AdaptedSensitivity;
			this.ElevationAngle = Mathf.Clamp(this.ElevationAngle, -89f, 89f);
		}
	}

	private void UpdateCameraPositionAndRotation()

public class PhysicsRateAdapter : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x060018F2 RID: 6386 RVA: 0x0006AE19 File Offset: 0x00069019
	public void UpdateRate()
	{
		this.updateTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.updateFrequency;
		if (this.updateTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.AdaptRate();
			this.updateTimer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060018F3 RID: 6387 RVA: 0x0006AE54 File Offset: 0x00069054
	private void AdaptRate()
	{
		if (!this.useFixedTimeAdapting)
		{
			Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1f / this.maximumPhysicsRate;
			return;
		}
		int totalRealZombies = ZombieLoader.Instance.totalRealZombies;
		float time = Mathf.InverseLerp(this.minimumZombies, this.maximumZombies, (float)totalRealZombies);
		float t = this.curve.Evaluate(time);
		Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1f / Mathf.Lerp(this.minimumPhysicsRate, this.maximumPhysicsRate, t);
	}

		if (this.timer > 0.5f)
		{

			this.timer = 0f;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600158D RID: 5517 RVA: 0x0005F0AC File Offset: 0x0005D2AC

			requestTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble
		};
		this.requestIDGenerator++;

		if (this.requests.Count > 50)
		{
			this.requests.RemoveAt(0);
		}
		this.client.GetSpeaker.SendPing(pingRequest.id);
	}

	// Token: 0x0600158E RID: 5518 RVA: 0x0005F128 File Offset: 0x0005D328
	internal void ReceivedPingResponse(int requestID)
	{
		while (this.requests.Count > 0 && this.requests[0].id <= requestID)
		{
			double num = Time.realtimeSinceStartupAsDouble - this.requests[0].requestTime;
			this.client.myPingInMS = Mathf.RoundToInt((float)num * 1000f);
			this.requests.RemoveAt(0);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600158F RID: 5519 RVA: 0x0005F195 File Offset: 0x0005D395
	public void Cleanup()
	{

		this.timer = 0f;

	public void Display(PlayerMain player)
	{
		Vector3 vector = Camera.main.WorldToScreenPoint(player.transform.position + Vector3.up * 1.1f);
		base.transform.position = vector;
		string playerName = player.lobbyPlayer.playerName;
		if (!playerName.Equals(this.lastName))
		{

			this.lastName = playerName;
		}
		if (player.HasLocalControl || vector.z < 2f || !player.gameObject.activeSelf)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < this.markerImg.Length; i++)
			{
				this.SetImageEnabled(this.markerImg[i], false);
			}
			this.nameText.enabled = false;
			return;
		}
		this.nameText.enabled = true;
		PlayerMain.HealthState healthState = player.healthState;
		for (int j = 0; j < this.markerImg.Length; j++)
		{
			this.SetImageEnabled(this.markerImg[j], healthState == (PlayerMain.HealthState)j);
		}
		if (player.lobbyPlayer != null && player != this.lastPlayer)
		{
			Color color = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerColor(player.lobbyPlayer.colorCode);
			color = Color.Lerp(color, Color.white, 0.3f);
			this.nameText.color = color;
			color.a = 0.7f;
			for (int k = 0; k < this.markerImg.Length; k++)
			{
				this.markerImg[k].color = color;
			}
			this.lastPlayer = player;
		}
	}

		{

		{
			return;
		}

			Vector3 center = VendorController.Instance.MovePointAwayFromVan(base.transform.position, this.depenetrateDistance);

			Gizmos.DrawWireCube(center, Vector3.one * 0.1f);

public class RepeatedLaunchMatch : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000099 RID: 153 RVA: 0x00002FF4 File Offset: 0x000011F4
	private void Update()
	{
		if (!DebugController.DebugEnabled)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.timer += Time.deltaTime * this.freq;
		if (this.timer <= 1f)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.timer = 0f;
		switch (this.step)
		{
		case 0:
			ServerController.instance.StartSinglePlayer();
			this.step = 1;
			return;
		case 1:
			ServerController.instance.LaunchMatch();
			this.step = 2;
			return;
		case 2:
			ServerController.instance.CloseServer();
			this.step = 0;
			return;
		default:
			throw new Exception("Wrong step");
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600009C RID: 156 RVA: 0x000030E4 File Offset: 0x000012E4
	private static void RefreshBuildingData()

	// Token: 0x060013FE RID: 5118 RVA: 0x0005959C File Offset: 0x0005779C
	private void BakeAllRespawnableBuildings()
	{
		List<BuildingBlueprint> list = new List<BuildingBlueprint>();
		for (int i = 0; i < MapGeneration.instance.OpenPolygons.Count; i++)
		{
			Polygon polygon = MapGeneration.instance.OpenPolygons[i];
			if (polygon.HasBuilding && polygon.contentType == Polygon.ContentType.Residence && !polygon.allowsZombieSpawningAtBuilding)
			{
				list.Add(polygon.building);
			}
		}
		IEnumerable<BuildingBlueprint> source = from building in list
		where building.zombieSpawnPoints.Count > 0
		select building;
		this.allRespawnableBuildings = source.ToList<BuildingBlueprint>();
	}

	// Token: 0x060013FF RID: 5119 RVA: 0x00059631 File Offset: 0x00057831
	private void BakeAllRespawnableRoads()
	{
		this.allRespawnableRoads = (from edge in MapGeneration.instance.Edges
		where edge.roadType == GridEdge.RoadType.SingleLane
		select edge).ToList<GridEdge>();
	}

	// Token: 0x06001400 RID: 5120 RVA: 0x0005966C File Offset: 0x0005786C
	private void BakeBaseSpawnBuilding()
	{
		List<BuildingBlueprint> list = (from building in this.allRespawnableBuildings
		where DiffultyRegionFinder.Find(building.GetBuildingCenter()) == DifficultyRegion.Easy
		select building).ToList<BuildingBlueprint>();
		if (list.Count == 0)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Map has no houses on easy region!", LogSource.Match, LogMode.Error, false);
			return;
		}
		this.baseSpawnBuilding = list.GetUnityRandom<BuildingBlueprint>();
	}

	// Token: 0x06001401 RID: 5121 RVA: 0x000596CB File Offset: 0x000578CB
	public Vector3 GetBaseSpawnPoint()
	{
		if (DebugModifiers.General.SpawnAtRoad)
		{
			return this.GetRoadPoint();
		}
		return this.GetSpawnPointAt(this.baseSpawnBuilding);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001402 RID: 5122 RVA: 0x000596F1 File Offset: 0x000578F1
	private Vector3 GetRoadPoint()
	{
		return this.allRespawnableRoads.GetUnityRandom<GridEdge>().RandomPoint(Randomizer.Unity, 0.5f, 0.5f) + Vector3.up * 1f;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001403 RID: 5123 RVA: 0x00059728 File Offset: 0x00057928
	public Vector3 GetRespawnPoint(Vector3 deathSpot)
	{
		Vector2 b = deathSpot.xz();
		List<RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData> list = CollectionPool<List<RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData>, RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData>.Get();
		foreach (BuildingBlueprint buildingBlueprint in this.allRespawnableBuildings)
		{
			float num = Vector2.Distance(buildingBlueprint.GetBuildingCenter().xz(), b);
			if (num >= 50f)
			{
				list.Add(new RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData(buildingBlueprint, num));
			}
		}
		RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData buildingSortingData = list.Aggregate(delegate(RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData min, RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData current)
		{
			if (current.distance >= min.distance)
			{
				return min;
			}
			return current;
		});
		CollectionPool<List<RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData>, RespawnPoints.BuildingSortingData>.Release(list);
		return this.GetSpawnPointAt(buildingSortingData.buildingBlueprint);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001404 RID: 5124 RVA: 0x000597E8 File Offset: 0x000579E8
	private Vector3 GetSpawnPointAt(BuildingBlueprint buildingBlueprint)
	{
		if (buildingBlueprint == null)
		{
			Debug.LogError("No respawn building");
			return new Vector3(300f, 5f, 300f);
		}
		return buildingBlueprint.zombieSpawnPoints.GetUnityRandom<Vector3>() + Vector3.up + GeometryUtils.PolarCoordinateXZ(GeometryUtils.RandomAngleDegrees(), 0.2f);
	}

using System;

// Token: 0x02000231 RID: 561
public class ScreenFlashController : MonoBehaviour
{
	// Token: 0x06000FFF RID: 4095 RVA: 0x0003D7C2 File Offset: 0x0003B9C2
	public void Init()
	{
		ScreenFlashController.instance = this;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001000 RID: 4096 RVA: 0x0003D7CA File Offset: 0x0003B9CA
	public void Clear()
	{
		this.timer = 0f;
		this.DisableFlash();
	}

	// Token: 0x06001001 RID: 4097 RVA: 0x0003D7E0 File Offset: 0x0003B9E0
	public void SetFlashed(float duration, bool flashTurned)
	{
		if (duration > 0.001f)
		{
			if (flashTurned)
			{
				duration = 0.1f;
			}
			this.curDuration = Mathf.Max(this.entryTime + this.exitTime, duration);
			this.EnableFlash();
			this.isTurned = flashTurned;
			this.timer = 0f;
			this.UpdateEffect();
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001002 RID: 4098 RVA: 0x0003D838 File Offset: 0x0003BA38
	public void Update()
	{
		if (Pause.IsPaused)
		{
			return;
		}
		this.timer += Time.deltaTime * (this.isTurned ? 3f : 1f);
		if (this.timer > this.curDuration)
		{
			this.Clear();
			return;
		}
		this.UpdateEffect();
	}

	// Token: 0x06001003 RID: 4099 RVA: 0x0003D890 File Offset: 0x0003BA90
	public float GetFlashCoef()
	{
		float num = this.curDuration - this.exitTime;
		if (this.timer < this.entryTime)
		{
			return this.intensityCurve.Evaluate(this.timer / this.entryTime * 0.5f);
		}
		if (this.timer > num)
		{
			return this.intensityCurve.Evaluate(0.5f + (this.timer - num) / this.exitTime * 0.5f);
		}
		return 1f;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001004 RID: 4100 RVA: 0x0003D910 File Offset: 0x0003BB10
	private void UpdateEffect()
	{
		float flashCoef = this.GetFlashCoef();
		Color color = this.basicPanel.color;
		color.a = Mathf.Clamp01(flashCoef);
		this.basicPanel.color = color;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001005 RID: 4101 RVA: 0x0003D949 File Offset: 0x0003BB49
	public void EnableFlash()
	{
		this.isFlashed = true;
		this.basicPanel.enabled = true;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001006 RID: 4102 RVA: 0x0003D95E File Offset: 0x0003BB5E
	public void DisableFlash()
	{
		this.isFlashed = false;
		this.basicPanel.enabled = false;
	}

	public static ScreenFlashController instance;

	// Token: 0x04000D0D RID: 3341

	public void InitializeBar(int sectionsAmount)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < sectionsAmount; i++)
		{
			if (this.sections.Count <= i)
			{
				Image item = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<Image>(this.barSectionPrefab, base.transform);
				this.sections.Add(item);
			}
		}
		while (this.sections.Count > sectionsAmount)
		{
			UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.sections[this.sections.Count - 1].gameObject);
			this.sections.RemoveAt(this.sections.Count - 1);
		}
		this.fillMax = sectionsAmount;
		this.SetFillAmount(0);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C47 RID: 3143 RVA: 0x00030115 File Offset: 0x0002E315
	protected virtual Color GetHightlightColor(int index)
	{
		return this.greenColor;
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C48 RID: 3144 RVA: 0x00030120 File Offset: 0x0002E320
	public void SetFillAmount(int newFillAmount)
	{
		this.fillAmount = newFillAmount;
		this.fillAmount = Mathf.Clamp(this.fillAmount, 0, this.fillMax);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.sections.Count; i++)
		{
			this.sections[i].color = ((i < this.fillAmount) ? this.GetHightlightColor(i) : this.greyColor);
		}
	}

	public void PlayerEntrySync(LobbyPlayer player)

		int connectionID = player.connection.ConnectionID;
		this.GetSpeaker.SendInitialMapInfo(connectionID);
		this.GetSpeaker.SendMapSilhouette(connectionID);
		this.GetSpeaker.SendDifficultyRegions(connectionID);
		this.GetSpeaker.SendAllWaveData(connectionID);
		this.GetSpeaker.SendWaveBossKillStage(connectionID);
		this.GetSpeaker.SendAllInterestPoints(connectionID);
		foreach (LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer in this.lobby.players)
		{

			if (!(playerObj == null))
			{
				this.speaker.SyncPlayerInstantiate(playerObj, lobbyPlayer.lobbyID, connectionID);
				this.speaker.SyncPingMarker(lobbyPlayer.lobbyID, playerObj.pinging.PingPosition, connectionID);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600173B RID: 5947 RVA: 0x00063A60 File Offset: 0x00061C60
	public void OnConnectionLost(SteamP2PConnection steamConnection)
	{
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("On disconnect event, Connection ID = {0}", steamConnection.SteamID), LogSource.Server);
		int playerIndex = this.lobby.GetPlayerIndex(steamConnection);
		if (playerIndex == -1)
		{
			return;
		}
		LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer = this.lobby.players[playerIndex];
		int lobbyID = lobbyPlayer.lobbyID;
		bool flag = lobbyPlayer.playerObj != null;
		if (flag)
		{
			PlayersController.instance.DeletePlayer(lobbyPlayer.lobbyID);
		}
		this.lobby.RemovePlayer(playerIndex);
		this.OnLobbyPlayerRemoved(lobbyPlayer, flag);
	}

	}

	}

	// Token: 0x0600173F RID: 5951 RVA: 0x00063B4C File Offset: 0x00061D4C
	public void OnClientAuthAttempt(string version, string clientName, int connectionID)
	{
		if (!version.Equals(ZBVersion.Instance.FullVersion))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client " + clientName + " is not using same game version", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Version);
			return;
		}
		if (this.lobby.players.Count >= this.ConfiguredMaxPlayers)
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client doesnt fit. Max players reached.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Capacity);
			return;
		}
		SteamId steamID = SteamConnectionsController.instance.GetConnection(connectionID).SteamID;
		if (!this.Matchmaking.LobbyHasUser(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client not in Steam Lobby.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.NotInSteamLobby);
			return;
		}
		if (this.ShouldBlockBasedOnFriendship(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Client not friends with server owner.", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.NotFriends);
			return;
		}
		if (BlackList.IsBanned(steamID))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Banned player trying to auth!", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.Kick);
			return;
		}
		if (LobbyController.instance.IsRepeatedPlayer(steamID, LobbyPlayer.Type.Client))
		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Repeat player trying to auth!", LogSource.Server);
			this.KickPlayer(connectionID, DisconnectionReason.AlreadyConnected);
			return;
		}
		this.ClientWasAuthenticated(clientName, connectionID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001740 RID: 5952 RVA: 0x00063C50 File Offset: 0x00061E50
	private void ClientWasAuthenticated(string playerName, int connectionID)
	{
		foreach (LobbyPlayer lobbyPlayer in this.lobby.players)
		{
			this.speaker.AddLobbyPlayer(lobbyPlayer.lobbyID, connectionID);
		}
		SteamP2PConnection connection = SteamConnectionsController.instance.GetConnection(connectionID);
		connection.IsAuthenticated = true;
		int lobbyID = this.lobby.AddPlayer(connection, playerName, SkinID.Underwear, Gender.Male, AppearanceColorsHandler.AllocateColorsWithDefaults(SkinID.Underwear), 0, false);
		this.speaker.AddLobbyPlayer(lobbyID, -1);
		this.GetSpeaker.SyncMatchState();
		this.GetSpeaker.SyncMatchSettings();
		this.speaker.ConfirmClientEntry(connectionID, lobbyID);
	}

public class ServerMatchmaking : MonoBehaviour

	// (get) Token: 0x060017A2 RID: 6050 RVA: 0x0006463D File Offset: 0x0006283D
	// (set) Token: 0x060017A3 RID: 6051 RVA: 0x00064645 File Offset: 0x00062845
	public bool LobbyLaunched { get; private set; }

	// Token: 0x060017A4 RID: 6052 RVA: 0x0006464E File Offset: 0x0006284E
	public void StartSteamLobby(int maxPlayers, bool friendsOnly, Action failureCallback)
	{
		base.StartCoroutine(this.StartLobbyAsync(maxPlayers, friendsOnly, failureCallback));
	}

	// Token: 0x060017A5 RID: 6053 RVA: 0x00064660 File Offset: 0x00062860
	private void SteamMatchmaking_OnLobbyMemberJoined(Lobby lobby, Friend joined)
	{
		SteamNetworking.AcceptP2PSessionWithUser(joined.Id);
	}

	// Token: 0x060017A6 RID: 6054 RVA: 0x0006466E File Offset: 0x0006286E
	private IEnumerator StartLobbyAsync(int maxPlayers, bool friendsOnly, Action failureCallback)
	{
		SteamMatchmaking.OnLobbyMemberJoined += this.SteamMatchmaking_OnLobbyMemberJoined;
		Task<Lobby?> lobbyTask = SteamMatchmaking.CreateLobbyAsync(maxPlayers);
		while (!lobbyTask.IsCompleted)
		{
			yield return null;
		}
		if (lobbyTask.Status != TaskStatus.RanToCompletion || lobbyTask.Result == null)
		{
			failureCallback();
			yield break;
		}
		this.ConfigureLobby(lobbyTask.Result.Value, friendsOnly);
		this.LobbyLaunched = true;
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Successfully created Steam Lobby = {0}", this.CurrentLobby.Id), LogSource.Server, LogMode.Success, true);
		yield break;
	}

	// Token: 0x060017A7 RID: 6055 RVA: 0x00064694 File Offset: 0x00062894
	private void ConfigureLobby(Lobby lobby, bool friendsOnly)
	{
		string ipCountry = SteamUtils.IpCountry;
		WorldRegion worldRegion = friendsOnly ? WorldRegion.Friends : Geography.GetWorldRegion(ipCountry);
		DeveloperConsole.Log(string.Format("Starting in geo = {0}", worldRegion), LogSource.Server, LogMode.Normal, true);
		string countryName = Geography.GetCountryName(ipCountry);
		DeveloperConsole.Log("Country = -" + ipCountry + "- " + countryName, LogSource.Server, LogMode.Normal, true);
		this.CurrentLobby = lobby;
		this.CurrentLobby.SetData("region", worldRegion.ToString());
		this.CurrentLobby.SetData("country", ipCountry);
		this.CurrentLobby.SetData("version", ZBVersion.Instance.FullVersion);
		this.CurrentLobby.SetGameServer(this.CurrentLobby.Owner.Id);
		this.CurrentLobby.SetPublic();
		this.CurrentLobby.SetJoinable(true);
	}

	// Token: 0x060017A8 RID: 6056 RVA: 0x00064788 File Offset: 0x00062988
	public void EndLobby()
	{
		if (!this.LobbyLaunched)
		{
			return;
		}
		SteamMatchmaking.OnLobbyMemberJoined -= this.SteamMatchmaking_OnLobbyMemberJoined;
		this.CurrentLobby.Leave();
		this.LobbyLaunched = false;
	}

	// Token: 0x060017A9 RID: 6057 RVA: 0x000647C4 File Offset: 0x000629C4
	internal bool LobbyHasUser(SteamId steamId)
	{
		return this.LobbyLaunched && this.CurrentLobby.Members.Any((Friend friend) => friend.Id.Value.Equals(steamId.Value));
	}
}

		{

			this.shotHolder = gameObject.transform;
		}
		if (this.shotpool.Count > 0)
		{

			gameObject2.SetActive(true);

		}

	}

				this.TotalDownloadRate += steamP2PConnection.statistics.DownloadRate;

	public void ShowSpecific(TimeUntilWaveInfo waveInfo)
	{

			return;

	// Token: 0x06001B8B RID: 7051 RVA: 0x0007659C File Offset: 0x0007479C
	protected override string ConvertToString(TimeUntilWaveInfo waveInfo)
	{
		if (HelicopterLanding.Instance.DuringWaveState)
		{
			return TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<breakoutWave>");
		}
		if (waveInfo.mustKillBoss)
		{
			int currentlyEnabledBossTier = WavesController.instance.CurrentlyEnabledBossTier;
			return "Boss: " + BossfightController.instance.GetBossName(currentlyEnabledBossTier);
		}
		if (waveInfo.mustKillZombies)
		{
			string translated = TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<wave>");
			return string.Format("{0} {1}", translated, waveInfo.waveNumber);
		}
		string translated2 = TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<timeUntilWave>");
		if (waveInfo.waveNumber > 0)
		{
			string translated3 = TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<wave>");
			return string.Format("{0} {1} {2}", translated2, translated3.ToLower(), waveInfo.waveNumber + 1);
		}
		string translated4 = TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<firstWave>");
		return translated2 + " " + translated4;
	}

		catch

			return false;
		}

		{
			DeveloperConsole.Log("Localization File too big!", LogSource.IO, LogMode.Error, false);
			return false;
		}

	}

	public string Get(int row, int column)
	{

		{
			return "";
		}
		if (row > this.lines.Length)
		{
			return "";
		}
		TSVLoader.Line line = this.lines[row];
		if (column < 0)
		{
			return "";
		}
		if (column >= line.splitStr.Length)
		{
			return "";
		}
		return line.splitStr[column];
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C2D RID: 3117 RVA: 0x0002FAA0 File Offset: 0x0002DCA0
	public void CheckProgress()
	{
		PlayerMain playerMain = PlayersController.instance.MyPlayer();
		PlayerMovement.State effectiveState = playerMain.movement.GetEffectiveState();
		if (effectiveState == PlayerMovement.State.Walk)
		{
			if (playerMain.movement.speedCoef.x > 0.5f)
			{
				this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.WalkR, Time.deltaTime);
			}
			if (playerMain.movement.speedCoef.x < -0.5f)
			{
				this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.WalkL, Time.deltaTime);
			}
			if (playerMain.movement.speedCoef.y > 0.5f)
			{
				this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.WalkF, Time.deltaTime);
			}
			if (playerMain.movement.speedCoef.y < -0.5f)
			{
				this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.WalkB, Time.deltaTime);
			}
		}
		if (effectiveState == PlayerMovement.State.Sprint)
		{
			this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.Sprint, Time.deltaTime);
		}
		if (playerMain.arms.GetEffectiveState() == PlayerArms.State.AdsAim)
		{
			this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.Aim, Time.deltaTime);
		}
		InventoryItem pistol = playerMain.inventory.equippedItems.GetPistol();
		if (pistol != null && pistol.id != InventoryItem.ID.None)
		{
			this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.Inventory, Time.deltaTime);
		}
		if (playerMain.arms.EquippedItem != null)
		{
			InventoryItem.ID itemID = playerMain.arms.EquippedItem.itemID;
			if (itemID != InventoryItem.ID.None && ItemsBase.instance.GetItem(itemID).GetSubType() == DatabaseItem.SubType.SecondaryGun)
			{
				this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.SelectGun, Time.deltaTime);
			}
		}
		if (WavesController.instance.LastSpawnedWave >= 1 && !WavesController.instance.HaveToKillZombies)
		{
			this.AddProgress(TutorialController.TaskID.EliminateFirstWave, 1.01f);
		}
	}

	public void UpdateUIBarsAndChecks()
	{
		if (!this.IsDoingTutorial)
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = 0;
		int count = this.packs[this.curPack].ids.Count;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			TutorialController.TaskProgress taskProgress = this.taskProgress[(int)this.packs[this.curPack].ids[i]];
			this.taskUI[i].UpdateProgress(taskProgress.Normalized);
			if (taskProgress.Done)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		float fill = (float)this.curPack / (float)this.packs.Length;
		if (this.curPack == this.packs.Length - 1 && this.CurrentPackIsFinished())
		{
			fill = 1f;
		}
		this.mainCheckMark.SetFill(fill);
		this.fillBar.InitializeBar(count);
		this.fillBar.SetFillAmount(num);
		this.subCheckMark.SetFill((float)num / (float)count);
	}

	// Token: 0x06000C3F RID: 3135 RVA: 0x0002FDF8 File Offset: 0x0002DFF8
	public void UpdateUITextAndObjects()
	{
		if (!this.IsDoingTutorial)
		{
			base.gameObject.SetActive(false);
			return;
		}
		base.gameObject.SetActive(true);
		this.title.text = TranslationController.instance.GetTranslated("<instructions>");
		int count = this.packs[this.curPack].ids.Count;
		for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
		{
			TutorialController.TaskProgress taskProgress = this.taskProgress[(int)this.packs[this.curPack].ids[i]];
			this.taskUI[i].UpdateTexts(taskProgress.descriptionTag, this.GetButtonString(this.packs[this.curPack].ids[i]));
			this.taskUI[i].gameObject.SetActive(true);
		}
		for (int j = this.packs[this.curPack].ids.Count; j < this.taskUI.Length; j++)
		{
			this.taskUI[j].gameObject.SetActive(false);
		}
	}

	public void StackZombies(ZombiesToSpawn zombiesToSpawn)

			this.underwayZombieTypes[zombiesToSpawnTypeCount.zombieType].zombieStock += zombiesToSpawnTypeCount.amount;

	public void AbortCurrent()

		}

	// Token: 0x0600142A RID: 5162 RVA: 0x00059EAC File Offset: 0x000580AC
	public Dictionary<ZombieType, int> PopZombiesForSpawning(int spawnAmount)
	{
		if (spawnAmount > this.TotalStockedZombies)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Trying to spawn more zombies than there are stocked");
		}
		List<ZombieType> list = this.ListPossibleSpawnPackagedParticipants();
		if (list.Count == 0)
		{
			throw new Exception("TotalStockedAmount > 0, but found no possible spawn type");
		}
		Dictionary<ZombieType, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<ZombieType, int>();
		for (int i = 0; i < spawnAmount; i++)
		{
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new Exception("Ran out of possible spawn type");
			}
			int index = UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, list.Count);
			ZombieType zombieType = list[index];
			if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(zombieType))
			{
				dictionary.Add(zombieType, 1);
			}
			else
			{
				Dictionary<ZombieType, int> dictionary2 = dictionary;
				ZombieType key = zombieType;
				int num = dictionary2[key];
				dictionary2[key] = num + 1;
			}
			this.underwayZombieTypes[zombieType].zombieStock--;
			if (this.underwayZombieTypes[zombieType].zombieStock == 0)
			{
				list.Remove(zombieType);
			}
		}
		return dictionary;
	}

		{
			return;
		}
		List<int> spawnedZombieIDs = this.underwayZombieTypes[zombieType].spawnedZombieIDs;
		if (!spawnedZombieIDs.Contains(id))
		{
			return;
		}
		spawnedZombieIDs.Remove(id);
		if (this.TotalZombiesUnderway == 0)
		{
			AudioController.instance.PlayGlobalFX(AudioController.GlobalFXID.WaveEnd);
			this.MaximumWaveSize = 0;
			if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOnlineServer())
			{
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastGenericGlobalSFX(AudioController.GlobalFXID.WaveEnd);
			}
		}
	}

	public void RunFor(Transform target)

		list.Add(target.position);
		int num = 0;
		float num2 = 0.75f;
		float num3 = 9f;

		{
			Vector3 vector = list[num];

				vector2.Normalize();
				if (!Physics.Raycast(vector, vector2, num2, this.obstacles))
				{
					Vector3 vector3 = vector + vector2 * num2;
					if (Vector3.SqrMagnitude(vector3 - position) > num3)
					{

					list.Add(vector3);

	}

	public VaultIntersection FindIntersection(Vector3 position, Vector3 direction, VaultingTolerances tolerance, VaultSpotType? ignoreID = null)

		Vector2 normalized = direction.xz().normalized;
		for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
		{
			List<VaultSpot> list2 = this.vaultSpotCells[list[k].x, list[k].y];
			for (int m = 0; m < list2.Count; m++)
			{
				VaultSpot vaultSpot = list2[m];
				float t;
				if ((ignoreID == null || vaultSpot.id != ignoreID.Value) && GeometryUtils.SegmentIntersection(l, vaultSpot.line, out t) != null)
				{
					Vector3 vector = Vector3.Lerp(vaultSpot.p1, vaultSpot.p2, t);
					if (vector.y >= position.y - tolerance.lowerBounds && vector.y <= position.y + tolerance.highUpperBounds)
					{

						bool flag = Vector2.Dot(normalized, normalized2) > 0f;

		{
			return this.GetFillForWave(lastSpawnedWave - 1);
		}
		float startedTimerAt = WavesController.instance.StartedTimerAt;
		float timeUntilNextWave = WavesController.instance.TimeUntilNextWave;
		float fillForWave = this.GetFillForWave(lastSpawnedWave - 1);

		}
		return this.fillAmount[wave];

			float item = waveMarkerDescriptor.time / this.totalTime;
			this.fillAmount.Add(item);
			GameObject gameObject = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate<GameObject>(waveMarkerDescriptor.important ? this.bigMarkerPrefab : this.smallMarkerPrefab, base.transform);
			this.PositionMarkerTransform(gameObject.transform as RectTransform, waveMarkerDescriptor.time);
		}
		this.isPopulated = true;
	}

	// Token: 0x06001A69 RID: 6761 RVA: 0x00071834 File Offset: 0x0006FA34

	public void ProcessWaveSpawning()
	{
		this.checkForSpawningTimer += Time.unscaledDeltaTime * this.checkForSpawningFrequency;
		if (this.checkForSpawningTimer > 1f)
		{
			this.SpawnZombiesIfNecessary();

	// Token: 0x0600144C RID: 5196 RVA: 0x0005A590 File Offset: 0x00058790
	private void SpawnZombiesIfNecessary()
	{
		if (DebugModifiers.Zombies.DisableWaveSpawning)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (this.UnderwayWave.TotalSpawnedZombies >= this.maximumSpawnedZombies)
		{
			return;
		}
		int val = this.maximumSpawnedZombies - this.UnderwayWave.TotalSpawnedZombies;
		int num = Math.Min(this.defaultPackSize, this.UnderwayWave.TotalStockedZombies);
		num = Math.Min(num, val);
		if (num == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		PlayerMain randomPlayer = this.GetRandomPlayer();
		TerrainFeature terrainFeature = WaveSpawnLocation.FindFeature(randomPlayer);
		if (terrainFeature == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (KeyValuePair<ZombieType, int> keyValuePair in this.UnderwayWave.PopZombiesForSpawning(num))
		{
			this.SpawnZombiesAt(terrainFeature, keyValuePair.Value, keyValuePair.Key, randomPlayer);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600144D RID: 5197 RVA: 0x0005A668 File Offset: 0x00058868
	private PlayerMain GetRandomPlayer()
	{
		if (DebugModifiers.Zombies.WavesIgnoreHost && PlayersController.instance.PlayerCount > 1)
		{
			List<PlayerMain> list = new List<PlayerMain>();
			list.AddRange(from player in PlayersController.instance.players
			where player.lobbyPlayer.type > LobbyPlayer.Type.Host
			select player);
			return list.GetUnityRandom<PlayerMain>();
		}
		return PlayersController.RandomPlayer();
	}

	private void SpawnZombiesAt(TerrainFeature spawnFeature, int zombieCount, ZombieType zombieType, PlayerMain targetPlayer)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < zombieCount; i++)
		{
			Vector3 spawnPoint = WaveSpawnLocation.GetSpawnPoint(spawnFeature);
			UnloadedZombie unloadedZombie = ZombieController.instance.SpawnBasicZombie(zombieType, spawnPoint, false, true);
			this.waveZombieTargets.Add(unloadedZombie.identity.id, targetPlayer);
			if (unloadedZombie == null)
			{
				Debug.LogError("Wave Zombie didnt spawn, probably because it's near an active boss!");
			}
			else
			{
				this.UnderwayWave.OnWaveZombieSpawned(unloadedZombie.identity.id, zombieType);
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.SyncSingleZombie(unloadedZombie);
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x0600144F RID: 5199 RVA: 0x0005A755 File Offset: 0x00058955
	public void WaveZombieRemoved(int zombieID)

		this.waveZombieTargets.Remove(zombieID);
	}

	// Token: 0x06001450 RID: 5200 RVA: 0x0005A774 File Offset: 0x00058974
	public PlayerMain GetZombieTarget(int zombieID)
	{
		if (!this.waveZombieTargets.ContainsKey(zombieID))
		{
			throw new Exception("Target player for Zombie was not found");
		}
		if (this.waveZombieTargets[zombieID] == null)
		{
			this.FillNullWaveTargetsRandomly();
		}
		return this.waveZombieTargets[zombieID];
	}

	// Token: 0x06001451 RID: 5201 RVA: 0x0005A7C0 File Offset: 0x000589C0
	public void FillNullWaveTargetsRandomly()
	{
		if (PlayersController.instance.PlayerCount == 0)
		{
			throw new Exception("No Players for zombies to chase.");
		}
		foreach (int key in this.waveZombieTargets.Keys.ToList<int>())
		{
			if (!(this.waveZombieTargets[key] != null))
			{
				this.waveZombieTargets[key] = PlayersController.instance.players.GetUnityRandom<PlayerMain>();
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06001452 RID: 5202 RVA: 0x0005A85C File Offset: 0x00058A5C
	public void Clear()
	{
		this.checkForSpawningTimer = 0f;
		this.UnderwayWave.Clear();
		this.waveZombieTargets.Clear();
	}

	}

	// Token: 0x06000F79 RID: 3961 RVA: 0x0003B600 File Offset: 0x00039800
	public static float GetGunNoiseRange(DatabaseGun gun)
	{
		if (gun == null)
		{
			return 10f;
		}
		float num = Mathf.InverseLerp(15f, 150f, gun.dmg);
		num = Mathf.Lerp(15f, 60f, num);
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Shotgun)
		{
			num *= 0.5f;
		}
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Carbine)
		{
			num *= 0.7f;
		}
		if (gun.gunClass == DatabaseGun.GunClass.Pistol)
		{
			num *= 0.7f;
		}
		if (gun.supression == DatabaseGun.Supression.Suppressed)
		{
			num *= 0.5f;
		}
		if (gun.supression == DatabaseGun.Supression.IntegrallySuppressed)
		{
			num *= 0.25f;
		}
		return num * WeaponBase.instance.noiseMultiplier;
	}

	{

		if (playerMain == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		Vector3 position = playerMain.transform.position;
		this.CleanupOrphanMarkers();
		this.RecalculateCloseMakers(position);
		for (int i = 0; i < this.closeMarkers.Count; i++)
		{
			this.closeMarkers[i].UpdateDisplay(position);
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000551 RID: 1361 RVA: 0x00012C7C File Offset: 0x00010E7C
	private void CleanupOrphanMarkers()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < this.markers.Count; i++)
		{
			if (this.markers[i].HasNoTarget)
			{
				UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(this.markers[i].GameObject);
				this.markers.Remove(this.markers[i]);
				WorkbenchHashes.RemovedMarker(this.markers[i]);
				i--;
			}
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x06000552 RID: 1362 RVA: 0x00012CF8 File Offset: 0x00010EF8
	private void RecalculateCloseMakers(Vector3 playerPosition)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < this.closeMarkers.Count; i++)
		{
			if (this.closeMarkers[i].DistanceTo(playerPosition) > 22f)
			{
				this.closeMarkers[i].SetCloseEnough(false);
				this.closeMarkers.RemoveAt(i);
				i--;
			}
		}
		foreach (WorkbenchMarker workbenchMarker in WorkbenchHashes.GetSurrondingMarkers(playerPosition))
		{
			if (workbenchMarker.DistanceTo(playerPosition) < 22f && !this.closeMarkers.Contains(workbenchMarker))
			{
				this.closeMarkers.Add(workbenchMarker);
				workbenchMarker.SetCloseEnough(true);
			}
		}
	}

		}

	}

	// Token: 0x0600069B RID: 1691 RVA: 0x00017C88 File Offset: 0x00015E88
	private int CalculateMaxZombieCount()
	{
		int num = 0;
		MapHash mapHash = MapHash.instance;
		for (int i = 0; i < mapHash.width; i++)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < mapHash.height; j++)
			{
				num += mapHash.GetCell(i, j).curMaxZombies;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}

	// Token: 0x0600069C RID: 1692 RVA: 0x00017CD0 File Offset: 0x00015ED0
	public void CalculateCellZombieCount(HashCell cell)
	{
		float num = 0f;
		if (!cell.hasContent)
		{
			cell.curMaxZombies = 0;
			return;
		}
		num += (float)(cell.nodesWithSize.Count + 1);
		num += (float)(cell.edges.Count * 3);
		foreach (Polygon polygon in cell.polygons)
		{
			num += (float)polygon.nodes.Count * 0.5f;
		}
		cell.curMaxZombies = Mathf.RoundToInt(num * this.populationSettings.baseZombieCountMultiplier);
	}

	private float GetBossSpawnAngle(ZombieType zombieType, BuildingBlueprint building)
	{
		if (zombieType == ZombieType.BossReaper)

			return building.BackwardAngle();

	// Token: 0x060006A6 RID: 1702 RVA: 0x000180A8 File Offset: 0x000162A8
	private static Vector3 GetBossSpawnPosition(ZombieType zombieType, BuildingBlueprint building)
	{
		Vector3 result;
		switch (zombieType)
		{
		case ZombieType.BossRiot:
			result = building.entryRoomCenter;
			result.y += 1.05f;
			break;
		case ZombieType.BossQueen:
			result = building.GetRandomFoundationCenter(true);
			result.y += building.RightFoot() * (float)(building.FloorCount - 1);
			result.y += 1.65f;
			break;
		case ZombieType.BossReaper:
			result = building.FindBellTowerRespawnPoint();
			result.y += 1.05f;
			break;
		default:
			result = building.RandomZombieSpawnPoint() + Vector3.up * 1.1f;
			break;
		}
		return result;
	}

	private void CountDownZombieRespawns()
	{
		this.zombieRespawnCounter += Time.deltaTime * (this.activeBossExists ? 0.1f : 1f);

		{
			return;
		}
		MapHash mapHash = MapHash.instance;

		{

	}

	// Token: 0x060006AD RID: 1709 RVA: 0x00018454 File Offset: 0x00016654
	private void RespawnZombiesForCell(HashCell cell)
	{
		if (!cell.hasContent || !cell.HasPhysicalRoads())
		{
			return;
		}
		bool flag = cell.curSpawnedZombies < cell.curMaxZombies;
		bool flag2 = this.zombieLoader.totalZombies < this.maxZombieCountGlobal;
		if (!flag || !flag2)
		{
			return;
		}
		UnloadedZombie unloadedZombie = this.SpawnZombieForCell(cell, false);

		{

			cell.curSpawnedZombies++;
		}
	}

	private void SnapZombieToPosition(Zombie curZombie)

		{
			return;
		}
		if (MultiplayerController.instance.IsOfflineServer())
		{
			curZombie.lastSyncPos = curZombie.obj.transform.position;
		}
		if (!ZombieController.ShouldSnapZombiePosition(curZombie))
		{
			return;
		}
		Transform transform = curZombie.obj.transform;
		if (Vector3.SqrMagnitude(transform.position - curZombie.lastSyncPos) > 0.25f)
		{
			transform.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(transform.position, curZombie.lastSyncPos, Time.deltaTime * 2f);
			curZombie.obj.body.position = Vector3.MoveTowards(curZombie.obj.body.position, curZombie.lastSyncPos, Time.deltaTime * 2f);
			curZombie.obj.body.linearVelocity = Vector3.zero;
		}
	}

	// Token: 0x060006B7 RID: 1719 RVA: 0x000188E8 File Offset: 0x00016AE8
	private void RecycleWaveZombie(Zombie curZombie, bool dumpZombie = false)

	// Token: 0x060006B8 RID: 1720 RVA: 0x0001896C File Offset: 0x00016B6C
	private void ProcessServerSideZombieDeaths(List<Zombie> zombies)
	{
		if (!MultiplayerController.instance.IsServer())
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < zombies.Count; i++)
		{
			Zombie zombie = zombies[i];
			if (zombie.state == ZombieState.Dead)
			{
				int id = zombie.identity.id;
				ServerController.instance.GetSpeaker.BroadcastZombieDeath(zombie.identity.id, true);
				MapHash.instance.GetCell(zombie.obj.transform.position).curSpawnedZombies--;
				List<int> killerLobbyIDs = BossDamageTracker.KillerLobbyIDs(zombie).ToList<int>();
				this.SpawnLootForZombie(zombie, killerLobbyIDs);
				ZombieType type = zombie.identity.type;
				if (zombie.IsBoss)
				{
					BossfightController.instance.OnKilledBossServerSide(type);
					this.TryCompleteMeleeOnlyChallenge(zombie, killerLobbyIDs);
					LoadoutUnlocker.instance.DistributeLoadoutUnlock(zombie, killerLobbyIDs);
				}
				zombie.DestroyAndSpawnDoll(this.zombieLoader.Prefabs.GetDollPrefab(type), type.IsBoss(), true);
				zombies.RemoveAt(i);
				this.OnZombieRealizedDeath(id, new ZombieType?(type));
				i--;
			}
		}
	}

	private void TryCompleteMeleeOnlyChallenge(Zombie zombie, List<int> killerLobbyIDs)
	{
		if (zombie.obj.customObj == null || !zombie.obj.customObj.TookExclusiveMeleeDamage)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (int lobbyID in killerLobbyIDs)
		{
			LobbyPlayer playerByLobbyID = LobbyController.instance.GetPlayerByLobbyID(lobbyID);
			if (playerByLobbyID.type == LobbyPlayer.Type.Host)
			{
				Challenges.Instance.CompleteChallenge(ChallengeID.KillBossMeleeOnly);
			}
